2.original: These are the well-named Black Hearts, the oldest dynasty in Mutant sports. Their veteran defense is savage, and their young offense takes no prisoners. They can smell your fear, and it makes them hungry.
2.translated: These are the well-named Black Hearts, the oldest dynasty in Mutant sports. Their veteran defense is savage, and their young offense takes no prisoners. They can smell your fear, and it makes them hungry.

3.original: I'm Coach Sputter, a throwback to the ancient era when the game was played with leg bones and severed heads. Ah, the old days. How I miss them!
3.translated: I'm Coach Sputter, a throwback to the ancient era when the game was played with leg bones and severed heads. Ah, the old days. How I miss them!

6.original: The Bruiser Bots' computer projections of their own speed and precision indicate that all other hockey teams should forfeit while they are still functional. Or they'll scrap you.
6.translated: The Bruiser Bots' computer projections of their own speed and precision indicate that all other hockey teams should forfeit while they are still functional. Or they'll scrap you.

7.original: Other coaches think my Bots are ruining the league. But, they're just trying to tie a suture around the future, because the future is us. If they could afford their own bots, they wouldn't be so ticked off.  Peace, brother.
7.translated: Other coaches think my Bots are ruining the league. But, they're just trying to tie a suture around the future, because the future is us. If they could afford their own bots, they wouldn't be so ticked off.  Peace, brother.

10.original: The Liars are a hungry team: They haven't won the Monster Cup in centuries and they raid concession stands between periods. They need to cook up a better defense and set the table for their offense, or their playoff famine will continue.
10.translated: The Liars are a hungry team: They haven't won the Monster Cup in centuries and they raid concession stands between periods. They need to cook up a better defense and set the table for their offense, or their playoff famine will continue.

11.original: Come on, baby, fight my Liars. I'm Coach Wimpson. What I lack in coaching ability and muscle, they make up for with a lack of listening and sportsmanship.
11.translated: Come on, baby, fight my Liars. I'm Coach Wimpson. What I lack in coaching ability and muscle, they make up for with a lack of listening and sportsmanship.

14.original: The Razors know that death is only a transitional phase to more death. They prefer quick scores to action-stopping fights, but anyone who wants a piece of them will find them sharp, on edge, and ready to retaliate.
14.translated: The Razors know that death is only a transitional phase to more death. They prefer quick scores to action-stopping fights, but anyone who wants a piece of them will find them sharp, on edge, and ready to retaliate.

15.original: I work the Razors up to a lather before each game. And as their coach, I can light a fire under them at the snap of my fingers, a whisp of my breath or just thinking about it.
15.translated: I work the Razors up to a lather before each game. And as their coach, I can light a fire under them at the snap of my fingers, a whisp of my breath or just thinking about it.

18.original: The philosophy of the Derangers is "kamikaze as you are". Klay-2 could lead their defense to greatness if they weren't so wild. Their uncontrolled aggression is a flaw, but they'll beat the snot out of you if you don't like it!
18.translated: The philosophy of the Derangers is "kamikaze as you are". Klay-2 could lead their defense to greatness if they weren't so wild. Their uncontrolled aggression is a flaw, but they'll beat the snot out of you if you don't like it!

19.original: I'm Coach Spleenin, head madman of the Derangers. When the hockey gods passed out aggression, I kept getting back in line.  My team knows not to upset me - so do opposing coaches.
19.translated: I'm Coach Spleenin, head madman of the Derangers. When the hockey gods passed out aggression, I kept getting back in line.  My team knows not to upset me - so do opposing coaches.

22.original: The Weenies get their butts kicked by every other team. Their goalie can't see the puck coming through his humiliating tears. Their body checks bounce for insufficient funds. Their coach sleeps through most games and wakes up screaming.
22.translated: The Weenies get their butts kicked by every other team. Their goalie can't see the puck coming through his humiliating tears. Their body checks bounce for insufficient funds. Their coach sleeps through most games and wakes up screaming.

23.original: I'm Coach McWhimple of the Mighty Weenies. I'm a coaching legend because nobody believes a coach as awful as me could really exist - Mrs. McWhimple owns the team. My teams have no offense or defense.
23.translated: I'm Coach McWhimple of the Mighty Weenies. I'm a coaching legend because nobody believes a coach as awful as me could really exist - Mrs. McWhimple owns the team. My teams have no offense or defense.

26.original: The Cads are more than a team, they're a cult. Players and fans both believe their destiny is to become "one" with the ice. Fanaticism combined with fearlessness has won them more Monster Cups than any other team!
26.translated: The Cads are more than a team, they're a cult. Players and fans both believe their destiny is to become "one" with the ice. Fanaticism combined with fearlessness has won them more Monster Cups than any other team!

27.original: My team is a perfect combination of Mutant Trolls, Mutant Skulls and Mutant Goalies. But could use more robotic character on the ice.
27.translated: My team is a perfect combination of Mutant Trolls, Mutant Skulls and Mutant Goalies. But could use more robotic character on the ice.

30.original: The Monsters don't know the meaning of the word 'Fear'. But their poor language skills don't stop their starters from being a top defensive team. What they lack in finesse they make up in savagery.
30.translated: The Monsters don't know the meaning of the word 'Fear'. But their poor language skills don't stop their starters from being a top defensive team. What they lack in finesse they make up in savagery.

31.original: I'm Bricka of the Monsters. The Monsters see me only as a cruel, merciless, heartless taskmaster who might 'dismiss' them for nothing more than a bad practice. They're right.
31.translated: I'm Bricka of the Monsters. The Monsters see me only as a cruel, merciless, heartless taskmaster who might 'dismiss' them for nothing more than a bad practice. They're right.

34.original: The Ooze used to be a good team, and their new coach will make them great, no matter how many times it kills them. He's taught them to work hard. The next lessons are how to play defense and score goals.
34.translated: The Ooze used to be a good team, and their new coach will make them great, no matter how many times it kills them. He's taught them to work hard. The next lessons are how to play defense and score goals.

35.original: The Ooze haven't been with me very long, but I'll remake them in my own image by the end of our first season together. By that time, they should be worshipping me.
35.translated: The Ooze haven't been with me very long, but I'll remake them in my own image by the end of our first season together. By that time, they should be worshipping me.

38.original: The Slammers deliver checks your body can't cash. Kyrka and Warhog score more than some basketball teams. Nobody's won as many games as them. Maybe nobody ever will.
38.translated: The Slammers deliver checks your body can't cash. Kyrka and Warhog score more than some basketball teams. Nobody's won as many games as them. Maybe nobody ever will.

39.original: I taught my War Slammers to be head bangers. Concussions make them meaner. Meaner is what it takes to win in the Mutant league. And win in this league is what I want - now!
39.translated: I taught my War Slammers to be head bangers. Concussions make them meaner. Meaner is what it takes to win in the Mutant league. And win in this league is what I want - now!

42.original: These Dragons are a fire-breathing team with a long, dark history. Rapier is their top scoring threat, but Half Nelson is their star player. They have a 4-skull rating, but a 50-skull collection.
42.translated: These Dragons are a fire-breathing team with a long, dark history. Rapier is their top scoring threat, but Half Nelson is their star player. They have a 4-skull rating, but a 50-skull collection.

43.original: I train the Dragons so they won't need much coaching during an actual game. That way, I can pound the fans when they get out of line.
43.translated: I train the Dragons so they won't need much coaching during an actual game. That way, I can pound the fans when they get out of line.

46.original: The Things' offensive philosophy is "better dead than bled". They hold the season scoring record in their bony grasp, and no living thing is as speedy as them. They terminate rallies by terminating the ralliers.
46.translated: The Things' offensive philosophy is "better dead than bled". They hold the season scoring record in their bony grasp, and no living thing is as speedy as them. They terminate rallies by terminating the ralliers.

47.original: My chip set is state of the art technology. Simple calculation of Dead Things playing skills and scoring capacity is high - even though they were once flesh-covered, aerobic, bi-peds.
47.translated: My chip set is state of the art technology. Simple calculation of Dead Things playing skills and scoring capacity is high - even though they were once flesh-covered, aerobic, bi-peds.

50.original: The Slashers skate like madmen: they're committed in more ways than one. Superstar enforcer Jack Slam really straight-jackets enemy offenses. And their fans generate an extra jolt of shock therapy for opponents.
50.translated: The Slashers skate like madmen: they're committed in more ways than one. Superstar enforcer Jack Slam really straight-jackets enemy offenses. And their fans generate an extra jolt of shock therapy for opponents.

51.original: You don't have to be crazy to play in the Mutant League, you have to be criminally insane. The way I coach the Slashers, they are extremely over-qualified.
51.translated: You don't have to be crazy to play in the Mutant League, you have to be criminally insane. The way I coach the Slashers, they are extremely over-qualified.

54.original: No other team is as cold-blooded as the Lizard Kingz. they strike like cobras around the net, and their defense constricts around opposing offenses. they're so slow they seem to crawl on their bellies, but their fists and sticks move like a blur.
54.translated: No other team is as cold-blooded as the Lizard Kingz. they strike like cobras around the net, and their defense constricts around opposing offenses. they're so slow they seem to crawl on their bellies, but their fists and sticks move like a blur.

55.original: Nasty, corrupt, and blood-thirsty are the nice ways to describe my Lizard Kingz. I should know, cause I made 'em that way. They'd be a menace to society if there was any society left to menace.
55.translated: Nasty, corrupt, and blood-thirsty are the nice ways to describe my Lizard Kingz. I should know, cause I made 'em that way. They'd be a menace to society if there was any society left to menace.

58.original: The Pukes really hurl themselves into their work. their powerful defense splatters opponents, and their scorers really churn around the net. Rarely do they boot a game. their wild style makes the rest of the league spit up and take notice.
58.translated: The Pukes really hurl themselves into their work. their powerful defense splatters opponents, and their scorers really churn around the net. Rarely do they boot a game. their wild style makes the rest of the league spit up and take notice.

59.original: I coach the Pukes to be as nauseating as possible. they've made a real splash in the league recently. Our team motto is 'Disgust or Bust'.
59.translated: I coach the Pukes to be as nauseating as possible. they've made a real splash in the league recently. Our team motto is 'Disgust or Bust'.

62.original: The Evils are a classic Mutant League team - with Reggie Fright playing 'D', nobody scores on them. When their offense concentrates on scoring and not sick jokes, they pepper the net.
62.translated: The Evils are a classic Mutant League team - with Reggie Fright playing 'D', nobody scores on them. When their offense concentrates on scoring and not sick jokes, they pepper the net.

63.original: The way I coach, we're misnamed. We should just be 'the Evils'. It's our opponents who do most of the screaming - before, during and after a game.
63.translated: The way I coach, we're misnamed. We should just be 'the Evils'. It's our opponents who do most of the screaming - before, during and after a game.

66.original: There isn't much to say about this new Mutant League team. Standard expansion capabilities. There's no champion in their future any time soon. These shrimps would taste better dipped in cocktail sauce.
66.translated: There isn't much to say about this new Mutant League team. Standard expansion capabilities. There's no champion in their future any time soon. These shrimps would taste better dipped in cocktail sauce.

67.original: Some people call my coaching style unimaginative, unintelligent, unproductive and uninspired. And those are the team publicists!
67.translated: Some people call my coaching style unimaginative, unintelligent, unproductive and uninspired. And those are the team publicists!

70.original: The Slayers live and die by K.T. Slayer. When he's on the ice, they're a threat to any team in the league. When he's out of the game, they're a threat only to themselves.
70.translated: The Slayers live and die by K.T. Slayer. When he's on the ice, they're a threat to any team in the league. When he's out of the game, they're a threat only to themselves.

71.original: I'd be nowhere without K.T. Slayer. But we pay him so much we can't afford decent players to back him up. Not that I'm doing any complaining, Mr. Slayer.
71.translated: I'd be nowhere without K.T. Slayer. But we pay him so much we can't afford decent players to back him up. Not that I'm doing any complaining, Mr. Slayer.

74.original: The Trolz are the best bunch of players their coach ever possessed. He's really turned their heads around since he took over and made them more aggressive. Their hot tempers are a hellish advantage for intimidating their opponents.
74.translated: The Trolz are the best bunch of players their coach ever possessed. He's really turned their heads around since he took over and made them more aggressive. Their hot tempers are a hellish advantage for intimidating their opponents.

75.original: My coaching style has made the Trolz a hotter, more aggressive team. Like the rest of the league, even I know not to get 'the brothers - Mo and Spew' hot under the collar.
75.translated: My coaching style has made the Trolz a hotter, more aggressive team. Like the rest of the league, even I know not to get 'the brothers - Mo and Spew' hot under the collar.

78.original: The Techies are copies of the Gil-9000 prototype, but made from inferior materials. If they can remain intact, their scoring window is wide open and their speed superior. But kinetic impact shatters their substandard body casings.
78.translated: The Techies are copies of the Gil-9000 prototype, but made from inferior materials. If they can remain intact, their scoring window is wide open and their speed superior. But kinetic impact shatters their substandard body casings.

79.original: My Techies are programmed so well that as coaching unit, my duties are not required during game sequencing. I often go into power reserve mode when the players take to ice.
79.translated: My Techies are programmed so well that as coaching unit, my duties are not required during game sequencing. I often go into power reserve mode when the players take to ice.

82.original: This is the Toxic Conference All-Pros. Bones Jackson is clearly the class of the league and his offensive leadership makes scoring simple - and often.  They've also got the two best goalies in the game.
82.translated: This is the Toxic Conference All-Pros. Bones Jackson is clearly the class of the league and his offensive leadership makes scoring simple - and often.  They've also got the two best goalies in the game.

83.original: It has been my coaching dream to take the best players from the Toxic Conference and mold them into a brutal, single-minded, merciless hockey juggernaut. Things seem to be working out better than planned.
83.translated: It has been my coaching dream to take the best players from the Toxic Conference and mold them into a brutal, single-minded, merciless hockey juggernaut. Things seem to be working out better than planned.

86.original: This year's All-Stars team is loaded to the gills - starting with Gil-9000 at center, including the 'the brothers - Mo and Spew' and featuring Mr. K.T. Slayer.
86.translated: This year's All-Stars team is loaded to the gills - starting with Gil-9000 at center, including the 'the brothers - Mo and Spew' and featuring Mr. K.T. Slayer.

87.original: I just send the All-Stars out onto the ice to win and they hope the other team sticks around for the final horn to sound. The game's usually over much sooner.
87.translated: I just send the All-Stars out onto the ice to win and they hope the other team sticks around for the final horn to sound. The game's usually over much sooner.

90.original: The Aces are the ultimate M.L.H. team - a combination of all the best players from both conferences. The only reason to play them is if you want some openings in your roster - or in your chest.
90.translated: The Aces are the ultimate M.L.H. team - a combination of all the best players from both conferences. The only reason to play them is if you want some openings in your roster - or in your chest.

91.original: I'm the only coach that could get Bones Jackson and K.T. Slayer to play 'with' each other rather than destroy each other. This league's lucky I'm sooo kind-hearted -- NOT!
91.translated: I'm the only coach that could get Bones Jackson and K.T. Slayer to play 'with' each other rather than destroy each other. This league's lucky I'm sooo kind-hearted -- NOT!

880.original: This is gonna be a snap. Their legs are gonna snap, their necks are gonna snap...

882.original: We all know this is going to be easy, but that's no excuse for figure skating during the game or shaving the ice to build snowmen.

895.original: There'll be a cash bonus and an extra ration of carrion for every goal scored and for every ghoul scarred tonight.

896.original: This game should be murder but if it's just aggravated manslaughter, I'll know you guys are dogging it.

897.original: We've got a far out chance to strike some sparks against the }, robot dudes.

898.original: In this game, you robot dudes are wired for sound... for a sound beating of the }!

899.original: I didn't say this game would be psychedelic. I said we'd slice up the } like salami at a psychotic deli.

900.original: Anything is possible tonight. It's possible you could beat the }. It's possible they could beat you. The only sure thing is I'll beat you if you lose.
900.translated: Anything is possible tonight. It's possible you could beat the }. It's possible they could beat you. The only sure thing is I'll beat you if you lose.

901.original: In a fair contest, the } would probably tie us. Good thing you're incapable of playing fair.

902.original: The talent on the } strikes an even balance with us. But we're a lot more unbalanced than they are, and that's our big advantage.
902.translated: The talent on the } strikes an even balance with us. But we're a lot more unbalanced than they are, and that's our big advantage.

903.original: I've worried myself sick over the }. They match us so evenly that anything could happen. I guess that means we could win.
903.translated: I've worried myself sick over the }. They match us so evenly that anything could happen. I guess that means we could win.

904.original: I can't watch. Games this even are too nerve-wracking. Just try to win without me. Like you always do.
904.translated: I can't watch. Games this even are too nerve-wracking. Just try to win without me. Like you always do.

905.original: Ever since I was a little barbarian, I've enjoyed even matches. They make cheating not only more fun, but more necessary.
905.translated: Ever since I was a little barbarian, I've enjoyed even matches. They make cheating not only more fun, but more necessary.

906.original: There is no substitute for victory. But there are substitutes for all of you if you lose.
906.translated: There is no substitute for victory. But there are substitutes for all of you if you lose.

907.original: The } are a perfect match for us. Think of this game as playing against a mirror image. But you'll have 7 years bad luck if you DON'T break this mirror.
907.translated: The } are a perfect match for us. Think of this game as playing against a mirror image. But you'll have 7 years bad luck if you DON'T break this mirror.

908.original: Analysis of opponent functional units indicates they are even with us. To achieve victory, erase this equality along with all rulebook files.

909.original: Unpredictable nature of upcoming contest precludes forecast of outcome. Creative rule interpretation is considered necessary for success.

910.original: An acceptable outcome to the imminent confrontation is contingent upon peak performance and efficiency by all units.

911.original: The } match up against us very evenly. You might be between a rock and a hard place. Play badly, and you'll be under a rock in a hot place!
911.translated: The } match up against us very evenly. You might be between a rock and a hard place. Play badly, and you'll be under a rock in a hot place!

912.original: Where there's smoke, there's fire. On the other hand, if you smoke the }, I won't fire you.
912.translated: Where there's smoke, there's fire. On the other hand, if you smoke the }, I won't fire you.

913.original: To beat the }, you'll have to give them hell. Just don't give them all of it.
913.translated: To beat the }, you'll have to give them hell. Just don't give them all of it.

914.original: In a game this even, sometimes you have to throw the rulebook out the window. If you get a firm grip on any } players, throw them out after it.
914.translated: In a game this even, sometimes you have to throw the rulebook out the window. If you get a firm grip on any } players, throw them out after it.

915.original: Playing the } will be like coming face to face with ourselves. Which puts us in a perfect position to give them some headbutts.
915.translated: Playing the } will be like coming face to face with ourselves. Which puts us in a perfect position to give them some headbutts.

916.original: The betting on this game is even. Or so I hear. Play hard or I could lose a lot of money... I mean sleep.
916.translated: The betting on this game is even. Or so I hear. Play hard or I could lose a lot of money... I mean sleep.

917.original: Mrs. McWhimple is in the stands tonight to give us heart. If we lose, she'll take it back, along with a few of ours to keep it company.
917.translated: Mrs. McWhimple is in the stands tonight to give us heart. If we lose, she'll take it back, along with a few of ours to keep it company.

918.original: Teams this evenly matched give me butterflies in my stomach the size of poodles like Mrs. McWhimple's pet poodle named Peepee. I hate that dog!
918.translated: Teams this evenly matched give me butterflies in my stomach the size of poodles like Mrs. McWhimple's pet poodle named Peepee. I hate that dog!

919.original: Whoa, deja vu, man. I just looked at the } roster and, like, they're almost exactly even with us.
919.translated: Whoa, deja vu, man. I just looked at the } roster and, like, they're almost exactly even with us.

920.original: Like, this reminds me of a battle of the bands I was in once. We were even except for our horn sections. Ours was sharper, so we gored them.
920.translated: Like, this reminds me of a battle of the bands I was in once. We were even except for our horn sections. Ours was sharper, so we gored them.

921.original: Our motto when we play the } has gotta be 'Go win, baby.' Just be glad you're not playing for McWhimple, cuz then it would be 'Go whine, baby.'
921.translated: Our motto when we play the } has gotta be 'Go win, baby.' Just be glad you're not playing for McWhimple, cuz then it would be 'Go whine, baby.'

922.original: Tough games like this are why we practice hard. They're why we play hard. And even though we aren't favored, they're why you'd better run hard if you lose.
922.translated: Tough games like this are why we practice hard. They're why we play hard. And even though we aren't favored, they're why you'd better run hard if you lose.

923.original: The } have an edge on us in talent. We have an edge on them in stupidity. That may not sound like an edge, but being too dumb to give up couldn't hurt us...
923.translated: The } have an edge on us in talent. We have an edge on them in stupidity. That may not sound like an edge, but being too dumb to give up couldn't hurt us...

924.original: I hope you've all signed up for our retirement plan. Many of you will have career-ending injuries by the time this game is over.
924.translated: I hope you've all signed up for our retirement plan. Many of you will have career-ending injuries by the time this game is over.

925.original: There'll be a blood drive during this game. Whenever the zamboni comes out, it will be driving through your blood.
925.translated: There'll be a blood drive during this game. Whenever the zamboni comes out, it will be driving through your blood.

926.original: Maybe if we just get out of their way and let them score a bunch of times, they'll get bored and go away. Then we'll win by forfeit.
926.translated: Maybe if we just get out of their way and let them score a bunch of times, they'll get bored and go away. Then we'll win by forfeit.

927.original: The } are so good that even if they beat us, we score a moral victory. Morality will get you kicked off the team. Score goals instead.
927.translated: The } are so good that even if they beat us, we score a moral victory. Morality will get you kicked off the team. Score goals instead.

928.original: You need to put on your game faces when you play the }. Maybe you should put them on backwards so they won't know when you're running away.
928.translated: You need to put on your game faces when you play the }. Maybe you should put them on backwards so they won't know when you're running away.

929.original: Opposition } units are superior in many categories to us. I suggest applying roto-tiller attachments to skates to damage ice and cancel their speed advantage.
929.translated: Opposition } units are superior in many categories to us. I suggest applying roto-tiller attachments to skates to damage ice and cancel their speed advantage.

930.original: We have a spread sheet on the }. If we do not perform at 100% of capacity, they will spread our parts in a sheet of oil all over the ice.
930.translated: We have a spread sheet on the }. If we do not perform at 100% of capacity, they will spread our parts in a sheet of oil all over the ice.

931.original: Don't take your visual condensor off the puck. Use telescoping occular extension if necessary.
931.translated: Don't take your visual condensor off the puck. Use telescoping occular extension if necessary.

932.original: The } are playing hotter than blazes. Make them suffer so you won't have to.
932.translated: The } are playing hotter than blazes. Make them suffer so you won't have to.

933.original: The } are more than a match for our defense. We may have to strike a few matches to light a fire under our offense.
933.translated: The } are more than a match for our defense. We may have to strike a few matches to light a fire under our offense.

934.original: You've got a lot at stake in this game. A lot of you will be burned at the stake if we lose it.
934.translated: You've got a lot at stake in this game. A lot of you will be burned at the stake if we lose it.

935.original: The } have massacred teams twice as good as us. If they do that to you, I'll come out to remove the wounded myself.
935.translated: The } have massacred teams twice as good as us. If they do that to you, I'll come out to remove the wounded myself.

936.original: You non-starters may have to hit the bricks if the } win. If you want to stay on the team, hit them with bricks first.
936.translated: You non-starters may have to hit the bricks if the } win. If you want to stay on the team, hit them with bricks first.

937.original: Our team health insurance has been canceled. The insurance company found out we were going to play the } and dropped us from their plan immediately.
937.translated: Our team health insurance has been canceled. The insurance company found out we were going to play the } and dropped us from their plan immediately.

938.original: The } always keep a cool head. They keep it in a bucket of ice by their bench. But don't let that intimidate you as much as it intimidates me.
938.translated: The } always keep a cool head. They keep it in a bucket of ice by their bench. But don't let that intimidate you as much as it intimidates me.

939.original: The } are way tough, man. This could get heavy, especially if they fall on us.
939.translated: The } are way tough, man. This could get heavy, especially if they fall on us.

940.original: Beating the } is far out... far out of the realm of possibility.
940.translated: Beating the } is far out... far out of the realm of possibility.

941.original: Ever wonder if you robots have a life after death? You'll find out for sure after the } get through dismantling you.
941.translated: Ever wonder if you robots have a life after death? You'll find out for sure after the } get through dismantling you.

942.original: To put this game on ice, you may have to put the } under the ice.
942.translated: To put this game on ice, you may have to put the } under the ice.

943.original: You'll have to put your noses to the grindstone to beat the }. But make sure you leave your masks on.
943.translated: You'll have to put your noses to the grindstone to beat the }. But make sure you leave your masks on.

944.original: It would warm the cockles of my heart if you win. But I don't have a heart to keep cockles in. Beat them to keep your own hearts beating.
944.translated: It would warm the cockles of my heart if you win. But I don't have a heart to keep cockles in. Beat them to keep your own hearts beating.

945.original: The } playing style scares me silly. Try to keep a cool, or you'll wind up frozen.
945.translated: The } playing style scares me silly. Try to keep a cool, or you'll wind up frozen.

946.original: If I seem distracted during the game, it's because I can't stand to watch it.
946.translated: If I seem distracted during the game, it's because I can't stand to watch it.

947.original: The } are going to eat us alive without salt. But at least they like us enough to make us the main course. That's kind of a compliment.
947.translated: The } are going to eat us alive without salt. But at least they like us enough to make us the main course. That's kind of a compliment.

948.original: Beauty is in the eye of the beholder, unless you're gouging it out. The only way the } won't beat you is if they can't see you.
948.translated: Beauty is in the eye of the beholder, unless you're gouging it out. The only way the } won't beat you is if they can't see you.

949.original: I taught you guys everything I know about being a psychopath. Good thing, too, because you have to be crazy to play the }.
949.translated: I taught you guys everything I know about being a psychopath. Good thing, too, because you have to be crazy to play the }.

950.original: Hockey is the moral equivalent of war. You have to play hard against a team as good as the } or you become the moral equivalent of mulch.
950.translated: Hockey is the moral equivalent of war. You have to play hard against a team as good as the } or you become the moral equivalent of mulch.

951.original: Odds indicate strong likelihood of defeat by the }. Defy the odds, or face a long visit to a short dismantling table.
951.translated: Odds indicate strong likelihood of defeat by the }. Defy the odds, or face a long visit to a short dismantling table.

952.original: Scouting data indicates the } are superior in both offensive execution, defensive execution, and all forms of execution. Prepare to become spare parts.
952.translated: Scouting data indicates the } are superior in both offensive execution, defensive execution, and all forms of execution. Prepare to become spare parts.

953.original: The } will be putty in our hands. But we will be scrap iron in theirs.
953.translated: The } will be putty in our hands. But we will be scrap iron in theirs.

954.original: The } make the upcoming game like jumping out of the frying pan and into the fire. If you lose, that won't be just a figure of speech.
954.translated: The } make the upcoming game like jumping out of the frying pan and into the fire. If you lose, that won't be just a figure of speech.

955.original: A game against the } is one of those times that try men's souls. Since most of you don't have souls and aren't men, just try to win.
955.translated: A game against the } is one of those times that try men's souls. Since most of you don't have souls and aren't men, just try to win.

956.original: Playing against the } is like playing with fire, but less fun. Try not to get incinerated.
956.translated: Playing against the } is like playing with fire, but less fun. Try not to get incinerated.

957.original: Mrs. McWhimple is sure you'll all do your best against the }. I'm too scared of her to tell her that your best will still get you slaughtered.
957.translated: Mrs. McWhimple is sure you'll all do your best against the }. I'm too scared of her to tell her that your best will still get you slaughtered.

958.original: Don't torture yourselves if you lose to the }. They'll torture you while you're losing, so it would just be redundant.
958.translated: Don't torture yourselves if you lose to the }. They'll torture you while you're losing, so it would just be redundant.

959.original: Playing the } always bums me out. After we lose, I'll be out of job and living like a bum.
959.translated: Playing the } always bums me out. After we lose, I'll be out of job and living like a bum.

960.original: Facing off against the } won't just be a trip, it'll be a vacation... from our heads.
960.translated: Facing off against the } won't just be a trip, it'll be a vacation... from our heads.

961.original: The } believe in flower power. To them, that means providing all the floral wreaths when they send you to your grave.
961.translated: The } believe in flower power. To them, that means providing all the floral wreaths when they send you to your grave.

962.original: If the whole playoff series is as easy as this game, you'll never have to break a rule or take a cheap shot. But don't let that stop you.
962.translated: If the whole playoff series is as easy as this game, you'll never have to break a rule or take a cheap shot. But don't let that stop you.

963.original: Don't take the } lightly. Take them darkly, cruelly, and bloodily.
963.translated: Don't take the } lightly. Take them darkly, cruelly, and bloodily.

964.original: Maybe this isn't as easy as it looks, a cunning trap, its cruel jaws about to snap on us and we'll die screaming! Then again maybe the } really are feebs.
964.translated: Maybe this isn't as easy as it looks, a cunning trap, its cruel jaws about to snap on us and we'll die screaming! Then again maybe the } really are feebs.

965.original: This game looks easy. Too easy. The crowd is too quiet. I don't like the way the hot dog vendors are grinning. Something is going on.
965.translated: This game looks easy. Too easy. The crowd is too quiet. I don't like the way the hot dog vendors are grinning. Something is going on.

966.original: I'll be watching the game from the locker room. If I doze off, I don't want to fall over and impale myself on somebody's stick.
966.translated: I'll be watching the game from the locker room. If I doze off, I don't want to fall over and impale myself on somebody's stick.

967.original: The } got into the playoffs on a wing and a prayer. Send them out on a stretcher and last rites.
967.translated: The } got into the playoffs on a wing and a prayer. Send them out on a stretcher and last rites.

968.original: It's insulting that we have to play a team as bad as the } in the playoffs. Go out there and add injury to insult.
968.translated: It's insulting that we have to play a team as bad as the } in the playoffs. Go out there and add injury to insult.

969.original: The combustion systems of the } are inefficient, enriching their exhaust with partially burned hydrocarbons. Idiomatic translation: They stink.
969.translated: The combustion systems of the } are inefficient, enriching their exhaust with partially burned hydrocarbons. Idiomatic translation: They stink.

970.original: If all playoff series are as noncompetitive as this one, we might as well start chilling the ethyl-based lubricant now to prepare for celebration mode.
970.translated: If all playoff series are as noncompetitive as this one, we might as well start chilling the ethyl-based lubricant now to prepare for celebration mode.

971.original: The } are doomed. They might accelerate but they cannot achieve concealment.
971.translated: The } are doomed. They might accelerate but they cannot achieve concealment.

972.original: The road to hell is paved with good intentions, but the road to the championship is paved with dirty tactics. Go do some roadwork.
972.translated: The road to hell is paved with good intentions, but the road to the championship is paved with dirty tactics. Go do some roadwork.

973.original: The } are hopeless, but we've got talent to burn. So go burn something.
973.translated: The } are hopeless, but we've got talent to burn. So go burn something.

974.original: Some say I speak with a forked tongue. That's only because I talk out of both sides of my mouth. But if I've told you once, I've you twice, the } can't beat you.
974.translated: Some say I speak with a forked tongue. That's only because I talk out of both sides of my mouth. But if I've told you once, I've you twice, the } can't beat you.

975.original: The } don't belong in the playoffs. I know you'll get 'em outta here quick as you can.
975.translated: The } don't belong in the playoffs. I know you'll get 'em outta here quick as you can.

976.original: The } skate like knock-kneed warthogs and handle the puck like it'll explode if they hit it hard. If they beat you, don't bother coming back to the bench.
976.translated: The } skate like knock-kneed warthogs and handle the puck like it'll explode if they hit it hard. If they beat you, don't bother coming back to the bench.

977.original: The fear in the eyes of the } is a dead giveaway that they're scared of us. So don't give away this game, or there will be fear in your eyes.
977.translated: The fear in the eyes of the } is a dead giveaway that they're scared of us. So don't give away this game, or there will be fear in your eyes.

978.original: Man, we could beat the } just by visualizing it.
978.translated: Man, we could beat the } just by visualizing it.

979.original: The } should be an out of sight team in the playoffs, robot dudes -- they're so scared of us they should have run out of sight by now.
979.translated: The } should be an out of sight team in the playoffs, robot dudes -- they're so scared of us they should have run out of sight by now.

980.original: We have one edge in this game -- the edge on your stick. Make sure it's good and sharp, use it whenever you can, and we should win.
980.translated: We have one edge in this game -- the edge on your stick. Make sure it's good and sharp, use it whenever you can, and we should win.

981.original: The } are an up and down team. Their best are great, and their worst are a lot like us.
981.translated: The } are an up and down team. Their best are great, and their worst are a lot like us.

982.original: The } are a real mixed bag. We'll need to mix them up by throwing bags over their heads to help us win.
982.translated: The } are a real mixed bag. We'll need to mix them up by throwing bags over their heads to help us win.

983.original: Even games like this make me more nervous than tough games do. Anything could happen -- usually anything bad.
983.translated: Even games like this make me more nervous than tough games do. Anything could happen -- usually anything bad.

984.original: The game is even but the } are pretty odd. It's also odd to be playing an evenly rated game.
984.translated: The game is even but the } are pretty odd. It's also odd to be playing an evenly rated game.

985.original: This game is yours to lose. So are your heads. If you lose one, you'll lose the other.
985.translated: This game is yours to lose. So are your heads. If you lose one, you'll lose the other.

986.original: The } are standing between you and the Monster Cup. The only way to it is straight through them.
986.translated: The } are standing between you and the Monster Cup. The only way to it is straight through them.

987.original: The } are going to make the conditions pretty slick out there. You'll need some extra weight for traction -- so put these horseshoes in your gloves.
987.translated: The } are going to make the conditions pretty slick out there. You'll need some extra weight for traction -- so put these horseshoes in your gloves.

988.original: Advancement in playoffs is potentially compromised by parity between this team's units and the }' units.
988.translated: Advancement in playoffs is potentially compromised by parity between this team's units and the }' units.

989.original: The }' units are so close to us in ability it is possible their existence is a violation of our patents.
989.translated: The }' units are so close to us in ability it is possible their existence is a violation of our patents.

990.original: This game is yours for the taking. Get fired up, or you'll get burned up.
990.translated: This game is yours for the taking. Get fired up, or you'll get burned up.

991.original: You're going to need a hot stick to score against the }. If you don't score, I'll stick you on something hot, anyway.
991.translated: You're going to need a hot stick to score against the }. If you don't score, I'll stick you on something hot, anyway.

992.original: The } are our equals, so we can't have any let downs. If we do, I'll let you losers down into a snake pit to work on your reflexes.
992.translated: The } are our equals, so we can't have any let downs. If we do, I'll let you losers down into a snake pit to work on your reflexes.

993.original: Even games can be worse than the tough ones. If you lose a tough one you're probably dead and you won't have to face me. Lose an even one and we'll talk.
993.translated: Even games can be worse than the tough ones. If you lose a tough one you're probably dead and you won't have to face me. Lose an even one and we'll talk.

994.original: You don't want to know what I'll do if you lose this playoff game. It'll be so quick you won't know what it is after I do it, either.
994.translated: You don't want to know what I'll do if you lose this playoff game. It'll be so quick you won't know what it is after I do it, either.

995.original: The } are like our twins, talent-wise. Do everything they do, but in the opposite direction.
995.translated: The } are like our twins, talent-wise. Do everything they do, but in the opposite direction.

996.original: They don't call us the { for nothing. They call us the { because we pay them to. We tried to pay the } to call us champs, but it didn't work.
996.translated: They don't call us the { for nothing. They call us the { because we pay them to. We tried to pay the } to call us champs, but it didn't work.

997.original: There's, like, this cosmic balance between us and the }, robot dudes. But these are the playoffs so forget that cosmic balance jazz and go kick some rear.
997.translated: There's, like, this cosmic balance between us and the }, robot dudes. But these are the playoffs so forget that cosmic balance jazz and go kick some rear.

998.original: If we want to stay hip to this playoff scene, we're going to have to take it to the }, even though they're no better than we are.
998.translated: If we want to stay hip to this playoff scene, we're going to have to take it to the }, even though they're no better than we are.

999.original: The whole season boils down to these playoffs. If we win, everything will be gravy. If we lose, everyone will be soup.
999.translated: The whole season boils down to these playoffs. If we win, everything will be gravy. If we lose, everyone will be soup.

1000.original: To win this game, we'll need the greatest possible effort from all hands. Those of you who don't have hands, try your best, anyway.
1000.translated: To win this game, we'll need the greatest possible effort from all hands. Those of you who don't have hands, try your best, anyway.

1001.original: I like you guys when you're not scaring me to death. So when I think about what the } are going to do to you, I feel like crying. I'll really miss you.
1001.translated: I like you guys when you're not scaring me to death. So when I think about what the } are going to do to you, I feel like crying. I'll really miss you.

1002.original: The } are nothing more than assassins. This game is going to hurt you a lot more than it hurts them.
1002.translated: The } are nothing more than assassins. This game is going to hurt you a lot more than it hurts them.

1003.original: Senseless violence really offends me. But the } are completely sensible about all the violent things they're going to do you, so I'm not very offended.
1003.translated: Senseless violence really offends me. But the } are completely sensible about all the violent things they're going to do you, so I'm not very offended.

1004.original: Advancement to championship mode necessitates overcoming the superior }. Peak multitasking on defense and offense is required.
1004.translated: Advancement to championship mode necessitates overcoming the superior }. Peak multitasking on defense and offense is required.

1005.original: Imminent contest portends greater than moderate chance of failure. Suppress sportsmanship programming immediately.
1005.translated: Imminent contest portends greater than moderate chance of failure. Suppress sportsmanship programming immediately.

1006.original: If we win this playoff against the }, we may earn enough bonus money to buy that chip replacement for our poor old widowed motherboard.
1006.translated: If we win this playoff against the }, we may earn enough bonus money to buy that chip replacement for our poor old widowed motherboard.

1007.original: The following hockey game contains scenes of graphic violence and adult language. No discretion is advised if you expect to win.
1007.translated: The following hockey game contains scenes of graphic violence and adult language. No discretion is advised if you expect to win.

1008.original: The } are badder than bad. Show no mercy when you cross sticks, or I'll show no mercy when you cross the Styx to my special training camp.
1008.translated: The } are badder than bad. Show no mercy when you cross sticks, or I'll show no mercy when you cross the Styx to my special training camp.

1009.original: The } plan to do unto us as we have done unto others. And they may be tough enough to pull it off.
1009.translated: The } plan to do unto us as we have done unto others. And they may be tough enough to pull it off.

1010.original: Your accomplishments this season will live forever. They're the only thing that will live forever, because the } are about to eliminate you.
1010.translated: Your accomplishments this season will live forever. They're the only thing that will live forever, because the } are about to eliminate you.

1011.original: The ice is gonna look like raspberry sherbet when the } are through with you. You came in as champions, but you'll leave as just desserts.
1011.translated: The ice is gonna look like raspberry sherbet when the } are through with you. You came in as champions, but you'll leave as just desserts.

1012.original: These playoffs have me played out. I can't think of a way to beat the }. You're on your own.
1012.translated: These playoffs have me played out. I can't think of a way to beat the }. You're on your own.

1013.original: The } are one of the toughest draws in the playoffs. Like, we're going to have to be on our toes or they're going to be on our necks.
1013.translated: The } are one of the toughest draws in the playoffs. Like, we're going to have to be on our toes or they're going to be on our necks.

1014.original: Dealing with the } in the playoffs is living on the edge: A long, sharp, jagged edge, and they're holding it against our throats.
1014.translated: Dealing with the } in the playoffs is living on the edge: A long, sharp, jagged edge, and they're holding it against our throats.

1015.original: Some people say that there is honor in losing to a team as good as the }. I don't understand honor. I understand winning.
1015.translated: Some people say that there is honor in losing to a team as good as the }. I don't understand honor. I understand winning.

1016.original: Be ready to go into the stands if you need to. When you play the }, sometimes you have to use fans as a shield.
1016.translated: Be ready to go into the stands if you need to. When you play the }, sometimes you have to use fans as a shield.

1017.original: The } can eat lesser teams alive. So if they come after you with a knife and fork and a jar of mustard, play dead.
1017.translated: The } can eat lesser teams alive. So if they come after you with a knife and fork and a jar of mustard, play dead.

1018.original: Games like this one could drive me to an early grave and the rest of you to a mass grave. The } are stone cold killers.
1018.translated: Games like this one could drive me to an early grave and the rest of you to a mass grave. The } are stone cold killers.

1019.original: Games against the } are like life: A long period of meaningless suffering followed by death and oblivion.
1019.translated: Games against the } are like life: A long period of meaningless suffering followed by death and oblivion.

1020.original: It's tough to keep your head above water in the playoffs, especially since the } will be trying to push your heads under it.
1020.translated: It's tough to keep your head above water in the playoffs, especially since the } will be trying to push your heads under it.

1021.original: Compute the effect of rust on your body casings. Activate metaphorical translator and compute the } as rust. Compute strategies to avoid them.
1021.translated: Compute the effect of rust on your body casings. Activate metaphorical translator and compute the } as rust. Compute strategies to avoid them.

1022.original: Remain in contact with puck unit but keep interaction with opponents to a minimum. They will rip out your wiring and floss with it.
1022.translated: Remain in contact with puck unit but keep interaction with opponents to a minimum. They will rip out your wiring and floss with it.

1023.original: If looks could kill, the } could fuse our circuits with a frown. Don't even make occular condensor contact with these units.
1023.translated: If looks could kill, the } could fuse our circuits with a frown. Don't even make occular condensor contact with these units.

1024.original: It's going to be a real inferno out there.
1024.translated: It's going to be a real inferno out there.

1025.original: The heat is on. You'll need a fire in your bellies to win against the }.
1025.translated: The heat is on. You'll need a fire in your bellies to win against the }.

1026.original: The season could be as good as over if you blow this game. Skate to be great, or you'll learn to burn.
1026.translated: The season could be as good as over if you blow this game. Skate to be great, or you'll learn to burn.

1027.original: As a coach, I don't expect my team to do anything I'm not willing to do. I'm willing run as fast as I can from the }. Maybe you should, too.
1027.translated: As a coach, I don't expect my team to do anything I'm not willing to do. I'm willing run as fast as I can from the }. Maybe you should, too.

1028.original: It's a darn shame that we've come this far only to be obliterated by a vastly superior team. But at least we tried. For all the good it did us.
1028.translated: It's a darn shame that we've come this far only to be obliterated by a vastly superior team. But at least we tried. For all the good it did us.

1029.original: Life is full of nasty surprises. Death is a lot more predictable. The } are a nasty surprise. It's predictable you won't live through the game.
1029.translated: Life is full of nasty surprises. Death is a lot more predictable. The } are a nasty surprise. It's predictable you won't live through the game.

1030.original: You're playing great out there. If you feel like you need some time out, eliminate one of the } and take a break in the penalty box.
1030.translated: You're playing great out there. If you feel like you need some time out, eliminate one of the } and take a break in the penalty box.

1031.original: The } are playing so far beneath us we could play fair and still win. But let's not take that chance.
1031.translated: The } are playing so far beneath us we could play fair and still win. But let's not take that chance.

1032.original: You guys are winning big and I've barely had to coach at all this game. I feel so useless and unneeded. Maybe I should crawl into a hole and hide.
1032.translated: You guys are winning big and I've barely had to coach at all this game. I feel so useless and unneeded. Maybe I should crawl into a hole and hide.

1033.original: It's hard to believe that a worthless insect like me could coach a team that's playing so well. Wait a mintue, which team's mine?
1033.translated: It's hard to believe that a worthless insect like me could coach a team that's playing so well. Wait a mintue, which team's mine?

1034.original: You're really on fire out there on the ice. That mixture of hot and chilly usually gives me a cold. But a win would be worth every sniffle.
1034.translated: You're really on fire out there on the ice. That mixture of hot and chilly usually gives me a cold. But a win would be worth every sniffle.

1035.original: I'm shocked at the lopsided margin of victory you're achieving. You should lop off limbs, not sides.
1035.translated: I'm shocked at the lopsided margin of victory you're achieving. You should lop off limbs, not sides.

1036.original: Whoever taught you to run up the score like that taught you wrong. You should run it up a lot more.
1036.translated: Whoever taught you to run up the score like that taught you wrong. You should run it up a lot more.

1037.original: Good work, but we're beginning to have a problem with violations: You guys aren't getting enough penalties. I don't think you're even trying.
1037.translated: Good work, but we're beginning to have a problem with violations: You guys aren't getting enough penalties. I don't think you're even trying.

1038.original: We're wired, they're tired. We've got chips, they're just dips. We're cybernetic, they're pathetic!
1038.translated: We're wired, they're tired. We've got chips, they're just dips. We're cybernetic, they're pathetic!

1039.original: Opponent units have an obvious bug in defensive programming. Fatal software failure is imminent.
1039.translated: Opponent units have an obvious bug in defensive programming. Fatal software failure is imminent.

1040.original: These opponent units aren't even depleting our batteries. We just keep going and going and scoring and scoring.
1040.translated: These opponent units aren't even depleting our batteries. We just keep going and going and scoring and scoring.

1041.original: You guys are hell on wheels, hooligans on ice, and hard as nails on the }! Just don't let up.
1041.translated: You guys are hell on wheels, hooligans on ice, and hard as nails on the }! Just don't let up.

1042.original: You guys are playing like men possessed! Which, of course, you are. Which, of course, I like.
1042.translated: You guys are playing like men possessed! Which, of course, you are. Which, of course, I like.

1043.original: Don't let up. The } could turn it on, take back the lead, and burst your Beelza-bubble.
1043.translated: Don't let up. The } could turn it on, take back the lead, and burst your Beelza-bubble.

1044.original: The way you're playing would make me proud if it was a little more shameful. Shame me with continued great play.
1044.translated: The way you're playing would make me proud if it was a little more shameful. Shame me with continued great play.

1045.original: I've never seen such a blatant display of savagery and disregard for life. I've thought about it, but I've never seen it.
1045.translated: I've never seen such a blatant display of savagery and disregard for life. I've thought about it, but I've never seen it.

1046.original: This reminds me of my first job in a slaughterhouse: A lot of cold air, a lot of doomed animals, and raw meat all over the place.
1046.translated: This reminds me of my first job in a slaughterhouse: A lot of cold air, a lot of doomed animals, and raw meat all over the place.

1047.original: Big leads make me so worried. It could just make the } meaner and tougher. I need to hide behind Mrs. McWhimple.
1047.translated: Big leads make me so worried. It could just make the } meaner and tougher. I need to hide behind Mrs. McWhimple.

1048.original: I hope beating the } like craven weasels doesn't tick them off. We've never been in that position before.
1048.translated: I hope beating the } like craven weasels doesn't tick them off. We've never been in that position before.

1049.original: As soon as we beat the } like a mildewed rug, let's get out of here fast. They might be waiting for us in the parking lot after the game.
1049.translated: As soon as we beat the } like a mildewed rug, let's get out of here fast. They might be waiting for us in the parking lot after the game.

1050.original: Amp down to reserve power, mechanical buckaroos. There's no use draining your batteries when we've got a lead like this.
1050.translated: Amp down to reserve power, mechanical buckaroos. There's no use draining your batteries when we've got a lead like this.

1051.original: The } are playing like they've stripped their gears, robot dudes. We can down shift now and still grease them.
1051.translated: The } are playing like they've stripped their gears, robot dudes. We can down shift now and still grease them.

1052.original: Don't coast just because you're winning. If you coast on ice, you can skid.
1052.translated: Don't coast just because you're winning. If you coast on ice, you can skid.

1053.original: The game isn't over yet so don't start congratulating yourselves. That goes double for those of you with split personalities.
1053.translated: The game isn't over yet so don't start congratulating yourselves. That goes double for those of you with split personalities.

1054.original: Watch for two pointers, they're hard to neutralize. And I'll neutralize anyone who lets one get past them -- unless we win.
1054.translated: Watch for two pointers, they're hard to neutralize. And I'll neutralize anyone who lets one get past them -- unless we win.

1055.original: I'd weep for joy at how well you're playing, but my tears might pit the ice. That could turn the game against us.
1055.translated: I'd weep for joy at how well you're playing, but my tears might pit the ice. That could turn the game against us.

1056.original: Don't get overconfident. In fact, be like me and worry yourselves sick. A fire in your belly and a bleeding ulcer are pretty similar.
1056.translated: Don't get overconfident. In fact, be like me and worry yourselves sick. A fire in your belly and a bleeding ulcer are pretty similar.

1057.original: I hope we don't damage the } players' self-esteem by embarrassing them this way. What am I saying? Of course we do!
1057.translated: I hope we don't damage the } players' self-esteem by embarrassing them this way. What am I saying? Of course we do!

1058.original: It ain't over til it's over. The } ain't hemorrhaging til they're hemorrhaging. But its almost over and they're getting pale.
1058.translated: It ain't over til it's over. The } ain't hemorrhaging til they're hemorrhaging. But its almost over and they're getting pale.

1059.original: This win will be the icing on the cake, especially since their blood is caking on the ice.
1059.translated: This win will be the icing on the cake, especially since their blood is caking on the ice.

1060.original: Don't rest on your laurels, they'll only slow you down and it's hard to get back up again.
1060.translated: Don't rest on your laurels, they'll only slow you down and it's hard to get back up again.

1061.original: Our forward momentum is overwhelming the inert state of opponent entities. Inertia can hurt ya.
1061.translated: Our forward momentum is overwhelming the inert state of opponent entities. Inertia can hurt ya.

1062.original: Maintain current playing levels and the ice will soon be debugged of enemy } virus.
1062.translated: Maintain current playing levels and the ice will soon be debugged of enemy } virus.

1063.original: Even our second string could zap the }' opposition units like a live wire.
1063.translated: Even our second string could zap the }' opposition units like a live wire.

1064.original: You're scoring so easily it's like shoveling the puck into the goal with a pitchfork.
1064.translated: You're scoring so easily it's like shoveling the puck into the goal with a pitchfork.

1065.original: You're moving the puck so fast it's glowing like charcoal! Keep it up and we'll barbecue the }.
1065.translated: You're moving the puck so fast it's glowing like charcoal! Keep it up and we'll barbecue the }.

1066.original: Don't sit on your lead, stand on their throats. Then jump and down excitedly.
1066.translated: Don't sit on your lead, stand on their throats. Then jump and down excitedly.

1067.original: It's all over now but the agonized screaming. Put some more hurt on the } and we can go home.
1067.translated: It's all over now but the agonized screaming. Put some more hurt on the } and we can go home.

1068.original: Don't let up now -- their wounds are crusting over and they're getting their second wind.
1068.translated: Don't let up now -- their wounds are crusting over and they're getting their second wind.

1069.original: You've forced their backs to the wall. Now bang their heads through it.
1069.translated: You've forced their backs to the wall. Now bang their heads through it.

1070.original: The game isn't over yet, so don't sit on your lead. Mrs. McWhimple sat on a lead once and it took a construction crane to get her back off of it.
1070.translated: The game isn't over yet, so don't sit on your lead. Mrs. McWhimple sat on a lead once and it took a construction crane to get her back off of it.

1071.original: The game is almost over and we're still ahead. This is going too well. Something bad is about to happen, I just know it.
1071.translated: The game is almost over and we're still ahead. This is going too well. Something bad is about to happen, I just know it.

1072.original: Make sure to polish your faces before the face-off, {. I want those } dudes to see clear reflections of what losers they are.
1072.translated: Make sure to polish your faces before the face-off, {. I want those } dudes to see clear reflections of what losers they are.

1073.original: See if you can't make this face-off a big kiss-off for the }.
1073.translated: See if you can't make this face-off a big kiss-off for the }.

1074.original: A tie is the next best thing to taking a beating. Keep it up and it will be the same thing. Go out there and win.
1074.translated: A tie is the next best thing to taking a beating. Keep it up and it will be the same thing. Go out there and win.

1075.original: A win is a step forward, a loss is a step backward, a tie is a step into something nasty.
1075.translated: A win is a step forward, a loss is a step backward, a tie is a step into something nasty.

1076.original: I'm on pins and needles because of this tie. If you don't break it, you'll be on bamboo stakes and railroad spikes.
1076.translated: I'm on pins and needles because of this tie. If you don't break it, you'll be on bamboo stakes and railroad spikes.

1077.original: The team owners will feed us to their pet alligators if we don't break this tie. Win it or lose it, it just can't end in a tie.
1077.translated: The team owners will feed us to their pet alligators if we don't break this tie. Win it or lose it, it just can't end in a tie.

1078.original: My stomach is tied in knots and so is the score. A win would really help my digestion. Ooh, my tummy.
1078.translated: My stomach is tied in knots and so is the score. A win would really help my digestion. Ooh, my tummy.

1079.original: That twanging noise you hear is the strain you're putting on my nerves. Break this tie or they may snap.
1079.translated: That twanging noise you hear is the strain you're putting on my nerves. Break this tie or they may snap.

1080.original: You've been very level-headed in this game. I hate that! If you don't break this tie, your heads will be level with your butts!
1080.translated: You've been very level-headed in this game. I hate that! If you don't break this tie, your heads will be level with your butts!

1081.original: A tie game is like death, but it hurts more. If this game continues as a tie much longer, you'll be able to verify the comparison for yourselves.
1081.translated: A tie game is like death, but it hurts more. If this game continues as a tie much longer, you'll be able to verify the comparison for yourselves.

1082.original: This tie is uglier than the ones I used to give for Father's Day! I guess I'm being paid back.
1082.translated: This tie is uglier than the ones I used to give for Father's Day! I guess I'm being paid back.

1083.original: Equivalent scores are insufficient to meet victory requirements. Reboot internal game drives and decompress 'don't be a wuss' program.
1083.translated: Equivalent scores are insufficient to meet victory requirements. Reboot internal game drives and decompress 'don't be a wuss' program.

1084.original: Isolate and control black vulcanized disk in preparation for placement in netted scoring locus with greater frequency.
1084.translated: Isolate and control black vulcanized disk in preparation for placement in netted scoring locus with greater frequency.

1085.original: Tie score suggests entropy has begun. Reverse this trend, or your heads will be displayed in the team entropy case.
1085.translated: Tie score suggests entropy has begun. Reverse this trend, or your heads will be displayed in the team entropy case.

1086.original: If you don't break this tie, you'll learn a whole new meaning to 'feel the burn'!
1086.translated: If you don't break this tie, you'll learn a whole new meaning to 'feel the burn'!

1087.original: A tie isn't good enough. Take over the lead or I'll send you down deep... REALLY deep... into the minors.
1087.translated: A tie isn't good enough. Take over the lead or I'll send you down deep... REALLY deep... into the minors.

1088.original: The heat is on. You've got to burn past the }, but make sure you don't flame out.
1088.translated: The heat is on. You've got to burn past the }, but make sure you don't flame out.

1089.original: You wimps have to start taking it to the } or I'm going to start taking it out of your hides!
1089.translated: You wimps have to start taking it to the } or I'm going to start taking it out of your hides!

1090.original: If this game ends up drawn after 3 periods, some of you will end up drawn into 4 quarters!
1090.translated: If this game ends up drawn after 3 periods, some of you will end up drawn into 4 quarters!

1091.original: You're playing for Bricka, not McWhimple! Even he wouldn't tolerate a tie! His neck is too weak.
1091.translated: You're playing for Bricka, not McWhimple! Even he wouldn't tolerate a tie! His neck is too weak.

1092.original: Since you're trying not to lose, my migraine isn't too bad yet. It would go away, though, if you actually tried to win.
1092.translated: Since you're trying not to lose, my migraine isn't too bad yet. It would go away, though, if you actually tried to win.

1093.original: I hate to think what Mrs. McWhimple will say if you don't break this tie. I hate even more to think of what she'll break.
1093.translated: I hate to think what Mrs. McWhimple will say if you don't break this tie. I hate even more to think of what she'll break.

1094.original: I never wear a tie and I don't want to be in one, either. Make sure you collar the puck in this face-off.
1094.translated: I never wear a tie and I don't want to be in one, either. Make sure you collar the puck in this face-off.

1095.original: It's our karma to win, but it's the }' to win, too. We're in the middle of a multi-karma pileup. Break this tie, or you'll get towed away.
1095.translated: It's our karma to win, but it's the }' to win, too. We're in the middle of a multi-karma pileup. Break this tie, or you'll get towed away.

1096.original: You're not trying. Show some fire! Get the eye of the tiger or I'll give you the face of a roadkill!
1096.translated: You're not trying. Show some fire! Get the eye of the tiger or I'll give you the face of a roadkill!

1097.original: I assume responsibility for your crapola play. But your families are going to have to assume responsibility for disposing of your remains if you lose.
1097.translated: I assume responsibility for your crapola play. But your families are going to have to assume responsibility for disposing of your remains if you lose.

1098.original: Playing well is its own reward. Playing as badly as you are deserves extra punishment. Which one you get is up to you.
1098.translated: Playing well is its own reward. Playing as badly as you are deserves extra punishment. Which one you get is up to you.

1099.original: When I was a baby wimp in a wimp litter, my wimp mama would take away our pacifiers by saying 'Quit sucking, you little wimps!' That's my advice to you, too.
1099.translated: When I was a baby wimp in a wimp litter, my wimp mama would take away our pacifiers by saying 'Quit sucking, you little wimps!' That's my advice to you, too.

1100.original: Could you please start trying a little harder? Or try starting a little harder? Whatever you do, try something different.
1100.translated: Could you please start trying a little harder? Or try starting a little harder? Whatever you do, try something different.

1101.original: Are you doing this to torture me because I make you practice? I asked you a question.
1101.translated: Are you doing this to torture me because I make you practice? I asked you a question.

1102.original: The way you're playing, I'm starting to think you're not just shaving the ice, you're shaving points!
1102.translated: The way you're playing, I'm starting to think you're not just shaving the ice, you're shaving points!

1103.original: You have to reach deep down inside yourself in tough games to see what you're made of. I'm going to reach deep down inside you if you lose!
1103.translated: You have to reach deep down inside yourself in tough games to see what you're made of. I'm going to reach deep down inside you if you lose!

1104.original: Either you start ripping up face-offs or I'll start up ripping off faces!
1104.translated: Either you start ripping up face-offs or I'll start up ripping off faces!

1105.original: Perhaps injecting granulated sucrose into your propellant reservoirs will energize you, you substandard set of non-victors!
1105.translated: Perhaps injecting granulated sucrose into your propellant reservoirs will energize you, you substandard set of non-victors!

1106.original: Performance data has fallen into the unacceptable range! Institute upgrade immediately or be reassigned to zamboni hood ornament duty!
1106.translated: Performance data has fallen into the unacceptable range! Institute upgrade immediately or be reassigned to zamboni hood ornament duty!

1107.original: Losing creates a short duration partial vacuum. Idiomatic translation: It sucks.
1107.translated: Losing creates a short duration partial vacuum. Idiomatic translation: It sucks.

1108.original: Your bad play has gotten the team's future into a grey area. Shape up or all that will be left of you is a grey area on the ice.
1108.translated: Your bad play has gotten the team's future into a grey area. Shape up or all that will be left of you is a grey area on the ice.

1109.original: The stinko way you're playing will make the upcoming Zamboni accident I arranged seem even more tragic.
1109.translated: The stinko way you're playing will make the upcoming Zamboni accident I arranged seem even more tragic.

1110.original: Report to the cinder track after the game for laps. I'm gonna turn you into cinders and run laps on you if you lose!
1110.translated: Report to the cinder track after the game for laps. I'm gonna turn you into cinders and run laps on you if you lose!

1111.original: You've got to start playing better at both ends of the ice or I'm gonna ram a hockey stick through both ends of your head!
1111.translated: You've got to start playing better at both ends of the ice or I'm gonna ram a hockey stick through both ends of your head!

1112.original: If the } keep burying you on the ice, you're going to start shivering like McWhimple when I'm through with you.
1112.translated: If the } keep burying you on the ice, you're going to start shivering like McWhimple when I'm through with you.

1113.original: The longest journey begins with a single step. A loss is like a single step in front of a speeding bus and a long journey stuck to the bumper.
1113.translated: The longest journey begins with a single step. A loss is like a single step in front of a speeding bus and a long journey stuck to the bumper.

1114.original: Mrs. McWhimple understands losing and having a bad game -- that doesn't worry me. She understands chainsaws, too. That worries me.
1114.translated: Mrs. McWhimple understands losing and having a bad game -- that doesn't worry me. She understands chainsaws, too. That worries me.

1115.original: Go ahead. Keep on losing. Whatever makes you happy. Don't worry about me. Coach Bricka never does. Neither does Mrs. McWhimple. Why should you?
1115.translated: Go ahead. Keep on losing. Whatever makes you happy. Don't worry about me. Coach Bricka never does. Neither does Mrs. McWhimple. Why should you?

1116.original: To look on the bright side of this, the way you're playing makes you prime candidates for come-back players of the year next season.
1116.translated: To look on the bright side of this, the way you're playing makes you prime candidates for come-back players of the year next season.

1117.original: Some of you are going to have to go back to the shop if you don't start scoring.
1117.translated: Some of you are going to have to go back to the shop if you don't start scoring.

1118.original: Either your hardware has gone soft or your software has hardened solid. Whichever it is, robot dudes, you'd better start taking some hard shots at the }' soft parts.
1118.translated: Either your hardware has gone soft or your software has hardened solid. Whichever it is, robot dudes, you'd better start taking some hard shots at the }' soft parts.

1119.original: I've got a travel advisory for you foul-ups: Get on the move or there'll be no place you can go where I won't find you!
1119.translated: I've got a travel advisory for you foul-ups: Get on the move or there'll be no place you can go where I won't find you!

1120.original: Gather close, lend me your ears. (SNIP!) Don't expect to get them back until you start playing better!
1120.translated: Gather close, lend me your ears. (SNIP!) Don't expect to get them back until you start playing better!

1121.original: If you lose, ignore any bricklayers who appear near the showers while you're in them. That wall they'll be making in the doorway is just routine maintenance.
1121.translated: If you lose, ignore any bricklayers who appear near the showers while you're in them. That wall they'll be making in the doorway is just routine maintenance.

1122.original: I blame this fiasco on myself. If I blamed it on you, you might get mad. Where's my blanket?
1122.translated: I blame this fiasco on myself. If I blamed it on you, you might get mad. Where's my blanket?

1123.original: Could you try to lose a little faster? It's so painful to watch you foul up so slowly.
1123.translated: Could you try to lose a little faster? It's so painful to watch you foul up so slowly.

1124.original: I'd scream at you, but I'm too depressed. If you don't improve, I might start whining.
1124.translated: I'd scream at you, but I'm too depressed. If you don't improve, I might start whining.

1125.original: This is your behind. This is your behind on the unemployment line if you don't win. Any questions?
1125.translated: This is your behind. This is your behind on the unemployment line if you don't win. Any questions?

1126.original: If you lose this game, you'll never be able to hold your heads high again... because they'll be in a pile and I'll be jumping up and down on them!
1126.translated: If you lose this game, you'll never be able to hold your heads high again... because they'll be in a pile and I'll be jumping up and down on them!

1127.original: If you just came to watch, we should charge you admission! If you don't start skating, you'll pay for it either way.
1127.translated: If you just came to watch, we should charge you admission! If you don't start skating, you'll pay for it either way.

1128.original: Get your cybernetic capacitors back in the game! Olfactory bulb implants verify you stink!
1128.translated: Get your cybernetic capacitors back in the game! Olfactory bulb implants verify you stink!

1129.original: The high tech firm that sponsors us needs automated sewage sorters. Low performance hockey units will be reassigned to this function!
1129.translated: The high tech firm that sponsors us needs automated sewage sorters. Low performance hockey units will be reassigned to this function!

1130.original: You game units couldn't locate your exhaust manifolds with both robotic arms and a compact narrow-beam illumination device!
1130.translated: You game units couldn't locate your exhaust manifolds with both robotic arms and a compact narrow-beam illumination device!

1131.original: Your play is trash! We burn trash where I come from!
