1131.translated: Your play is trash! We burn trash where I come from!

1132.original: We need a lot of scoring, fast. The first to get a hat trick gets a new hat and gets to keep their head so they can wear it!
1132.translated: We need a lot of scoring, fast. The first to get a hat trick gets a new hat and gets to keep their head so they can wear it!

1133.original: I'm not going to try to motivate you losers with any fiery screaming. That comes later if we lose: I'll provide the fire, you'll provide the screaming.
1133.translated: I'm not going to try to motivate you losers with any fiery screaming. That comes later if we lose: I'll provide the fire, you'll provide the screaming.

1134.original: I know you guys like to live on the edge. But you're playing on the edge of disaster. I'll push you over if you don't get with it.
1134.translated: I know you guys like to live on the edge. But you're playing on the edge of disaster. I'll push you over if you don't get with it.

1135.original: You know, lousy performances can result in freak accidents. Your parents supplied the freaks, so I'll supply the accident!
1135.translated: You know, lousy performances can result in freak accidents. Your parents supplied the freaks, so I'll supply the accident!

1136.original: The peanut vendors in the stands are more involved in this game than you are!
1136.translated: The peanut vendors in the stands are more involved in this game than you are!

1137.original: You've taught me a whole new meaning to the word "humiliation". I liked the old meaning better.
1137.translated: You've taught me a whole new meaning to the word "humiliation". I liked the old meaning better.

1138.original: I heard this pounding I thought was from the headache I got from your bad play. Then I saw it was Mrs. McWhimple building a gallows to string us up if we lose!
1138.translated: I heard this pounding I thought was from the headache I got from your bad play. Then I saw it was Mrs. McWhimple building a gallows to string us up if we lose!

1139.original: For every action, there is an equal and opposite reaction. Poor defense is your action, losing is the reaction.
1139.translated: For every action, there is an equal and opposite reaction. Poor defense is your action, losing is the reaction.

1140.original: Yo, Bot dudes, we're getting munched! We gotta swat 'em with our watts and clamp 'em with our amps.
1140.translated: Yo, Bot dudes, we're getting munched! We gotta swat 'em with our watts and clamp 'em with our amps.

1141.original: Rust never sleeps, but I'm not so sure about you Bots. I thought you were idling hard but maybe you were snoring. When you face off, wake up!
1141.translated: Rust never sleeps, but I'm not so sure about you Bots. I thought you were idling hard but maybe you were snoring. When you face off, wake up!

1142.original: Think of this O.T. as an RSVP: Respond Savagely with Vicious Plays. Think of losing this O.T. as an RIP: Removal of Important Parts.
1142.translated: Think of this O.T. as an RSVP: Respond Savagely with Vicious Plays. Think of losing this O.T. as an RIP: Removal of Important Parts.

1143.original: To win this O.T., we'll have to limit the }' perspective. Let them see the game only three ways: On their backs, looking up, and through a film of blood.
1143.translated: To win this O.T., we'll have to limit the }' perspective. Let them see the game only three ways: On their backs, looking up, and through a film of blood.

1144.original: I won't just send you down to the minors if you lose this O.T., I'll send you down to BE miners in the Toxicon sewage quarry!
1144.translated: I won't just send you down to the minors if you lose this O.T., I'll send you down to BE miners in the Toxicon sewage quarry!

1145.original: I think they were very nice to let us have this O.T. period. Try to win it, or we will just have to play another.
1145.translated: I think they were very nice to let us have this O.T. period. Try to win it, or we will just have to play another.

1146.original: I've been patient with you so far, mainly because you terrify me. But this O.T. is your last chance. Go out and win this one.
1146.translated: I've been patient with you so far, mainly because you terrify me. But this O.T. is your last chance. Go out and win this one.

1147.original: You seem to have something on your minds besides hockey.
1147.translated: You seem to have something on your minds besides hockey.

1148.original: You biological enigmatic mistakes made too many mental mistakes. Use this O.T. to evolve into winners.
1148.translated: You biological enigmatic mistakes made too many mental mistakes. Use this O.T. to evolve into winners.

1149.original: I can't impel you to win, but I can impale you if you lose. Get sharp in O.T. or get stuck after it.
1149.translated: I can't impel you to win, but I can impale you if you lose. Get sharp in O.T. or get stuck after it.

1150.original: Lousy play is the symptom. An overtime period is the disease. If you lose, there won't be any cure.
1150.translated: Lousy play is the symptom. An overtime period is the disease. If you lose, there won't be any cure.

1151.original: Game extension initiated due to scoring parity. Functional extension for player units also initiated. Loss of O.T. will cancel both extensions.
1151.translated: Game extension initiated due to scoring parity. Functional extension for player units also initiated. Loss of O.T. will cancel both extensions.

1152.original: Time coordinates recomputed for O.T. period. Win or your head coordinates in relation to your body coordinates will be recomputed due to separation.
1152.translated: Time coordinates recomputed for O.T. period. Win or your head coordinates in relation to your body coordinates will be recomputed due to separation.

1153.original: Unless you want my podiatral extension repeatedly applied to your pelvic junctures with swift upward motions, you will win this O.T.
1153.translated: Unless you want my podiatral extension repeatedly applied to your pelvic junctures with swift upward motions, you will win this O.T.

1154.original: H is for heinous, E for embarrassing, L for lamebrained, another L for losers. Put them all together, that's where you're going if you lose this O.T.
1154.translated: H is for heinous, E for embarrassing, L for lamebrained, another L for losers. Put them all together, that's where you're going if you lose this O.T.

1155.original: A team that loses in O.T. looks worse than a team that loses in regulation. Lose and you'll look a lot worse.
1155.translated: A team that loses in O.T. looks worse than a team that loses in regulation. Lose and you'll look a lot worse.

1156.original: A loss in O.T. can make a team's problems blow up all out of proportion. I'll blow you all up into gory little bits if you don't start to score some goals!
1156.translated: A loss in O.T. can make a team's problems blow up all out of proportion. I'll blow you all up into gory little bits if you don't start to score some goals!

1157.original: The closeness of this game takes my breath away. If you lose this O.T., I'll take your breath away by ripping out your lungs.
1157.translated: The closeness of this game takes my breath away. If you lose this O.T., I'll take your breath away by ripping out your lungs.

1158.original: You might think that this O.T. is the last chance we have to come out of this game alive. Wrong -- it's the last chance YOU have to come out of it alive.
1158.translated: You might think that this O.T. is the last chance we have to come out of this game alive. Wrong -- it's the last chance YOU have to come out of it alive.

1159.original: My image of your performance is that you are a deep pool of talent with a thin scum of stupidity on top. Win this O.T. or I'll see that you evaporate.
1159.translated: My image of your performance is that you are a deep pool of talent with a thin scum of stupidity on top. Win this O.T. or I'll see that you evaporate.

1160.original: This O.T. gives you another chance to win. It gives you another chance to lose, too. Now I wish I hadn't said that.
1160.translated: This O.T. gives you another chance to win. It gives you another chance to lose, too. Now I wish I hadn't said that.

1161.original: I view O.T.s with a mixture of horror and more horror. Mrs. McWhimple goes off the deep end when we lose them. And she usually lands on me.
1161.translated: I view O.T.s with a mixture of horror and more horror. Mrs. McWhimple goes off the deep end when we lose them. And she usually lands on me.

1162.original: O.T.s can be real heart stoppers. So can Mrs. McWhimple when she wants to -- which usually happens when we lose in O.T.
1162.translated: O.T.s can be real heart stoppers. So can Mrs. McWhimple when she wants to -- which usually happens when we lose in O.T.

1163.original: Don't get your wires hot just because this is an O.T. I already hot-wired you months ago.
1163.translated: Don't get your wires hot just because this is an O.T. I already hot-wired you months ago.

1164.original: We couldn't shut down the } during regulation, so we need this O.T. to jerryrig a win. No one is a spare part at a time like this. You're all necessary components.
1164.translated: We couldn't shut down the } during regulation, so we need this O.T. to jerryrig a win. No one is a spare part at a time like this. You're all necessary components.

1165.original: I'll take any win I can get, but you never really pulled away from the }. Don't forget, objects can be closer than they appear.
1165.translated: I'll take any win I can get, but you never really pulled away from the }. Don't forget, objects can be closer than they appear.

1166.original: Winning is all in your head. Since you won, I'll let you keep yours. Great job, I guess.
1166.translated: Winning is all in your head. Since you won, I'll let you keep yours. Great job, I guess.

1167.original: The } didn't just dig themselves into a hole, they fell into a mineshaft with no way out. Nice game.
1167.translated: The } didn't just dig themselves into a hole, they fell into a mineshaft with no way out. Nice game.

1168.original: I never thought we could do it. But when am I ever right? Well, sometimes, but you were right on tonight.
1168.translated: I never thought we could do it. But when am I ever right? Well, sometimes, but you were right on tonight.

1169.original: Good game. It almost gave me the will to watch you mutants play another one. Almost!
1169.translated: Good game. It almost gave me the will to watch you mutants play another one. Almost!

1170.original: A win is an even better pick-me-up than shock therapy. When you guys win, it IS shock therapy.
1170.translated: A win is an even better pick-me-up than shock therapy. When you guys win, it IS shock therapy.

1171.original: You took the ice like a barbarian invasion, and the } collapsed faster than an ancient civilization. Reminded me of the old days.
1171.translated: You took the ice like a barbarian invasion, and the } collapsed faster than an ancient civilization. Reminded me of the old days.

1172.original: You cast a long shadow over the ice today. Except for those of you who are vampires, of course.
1172.translated: You cast a long shadow over the ice today. Except for those of you who are vampires, of course.

1173.original: The } could have won that one, but they'd choke taking a shallow breath in a thin atmosphere.
1173.translated: The } could have won that one, but they'd choke taking a shallow breath in a thin atmosphere.

1174.original: Our cybernetic superiority has prevailed. Elevate and mutually impact flattened palms of quintodigital manipulators in celebratory gesture.
1174.translated: Our cybernetic superiority has prevailed. Elevate and mutually impact flattened palms of quintodigital manipulators in celebratory gesture.

1175.original: Acceptable result. The high quality of your circuit breakers enhanced your performance as leg breakers.
1175.translated: Acceptable result. The high quality of your circuit breakers enhanced your performance as leg breakers.

1176.original: Victory has been noted. You are all allowed one nocturnal cycle of celebratory rites. Bed check is indefinitely postponed.
1176.translated: Victory has been noted. You are all allowed one nocturnal cycle of celebratory rites. Bed check is indefinitely postponed.

1177.original: You really deserved that win. Give yourselves a round of stinging face slaps and tortured shrieks.
1177.translated: You really deserved that win. Give yourselves a round of stinging face slaps and tortured shrieks.

1178.original: Good win. It's nice to see that your bad playing habits didn't flare up again.
1178.translated: Good win. It's nice to see that your bad playing habits didn't flare up again.

1179.original: You toasted the }, cut off the crusts, and brushed the crumbs off the ice.
1179.translated: You toasted the }, cut off the crusts, and brushed the crumbs off the ice.

1180.original: Winning is nothing more than what you're supposed to do. Whaddaya want, a medal?
1180.translated: Winning is nothing more than what you're supposed to do. Whaddaya want, a medal?

1181.original: Winning one game only means you can beat losers. Don't celebrate until you're champions.
1181.translated: Winning one game only means you can beat losers. Don't celebrate until you're champions.

1182.original: You beat the } like a rug -- you just laid there and gathered dust while the } tripped over you. You won't beat a really good team that way.
1182.translated: You beat the } like a rug -- you just laid there and gathered dust while the } tripped over you. You won't beat a really good team that way.

1183.original: That win left me in tears. If we'd lost, Mrs. McWhimple would have left me in a bag by the curb on garbage day.
1183.translated: That win left me in tears. If we'd lost, Mrs. McWhimple would have left me in a bag by the curb on garbage day.

1184.original: You really mowed 'em down. Sprinkling them with weedkiller was a nice touch, too. Even Coach Bricka would be proud.
1184.translated: You really mowed 'em down. Sprinkling them with weedkiller was a nice touch, too. Even Coach Bricka would be proud.

1185.original: There were a lot of factors working against us -- hostile officials, an ugly crowd, brain damage -- but we still won. Probably never happen again.
1185.translated: There were a lot of factors working against us -- hostile officials, an ugly crowd, brain damage -- but we still won. Probably never happen again.

1186.original: You don't need to do logarithms to figure out we had that game won before it started.
1186.translated: You don't need to do logarithms to figure out we had that game won before it started.

1187.original: We won that game with our iron wills, robot dudes. And our iron wills were the }' last testament.
1187.translated: We won that game with our iron wills, robot dudes. And our iron wills were the }' last testament.

1188.original: You couldn't have shattered the } team ego any worse if you'd dipped it in liquid nitrogen and smacked it with a mallet.
1188.translated: You couldn't have shattered the } team ego any worse if you'd dipped it in liquid nitrogen and smacked it with a mallet.

1189.original: If hockey had a slaughter rule, that game would have been over a long time ago. Big win!
1189.translated: If hockey had a slaughter rule, that game would have been over a long time ago. Big win!

1190.original: When I told you to paste the }, I didn't mean into an album. But at least you flattened them out first.
1190.translated: When I told you to paste the }, I didn't mean into an album. But at least you flattened them out first.

1191.original: We couldn't have put the puck in the net any easier if we'd faxed it there.
1191.translated: We couldn't have put the puck in the net any easier if we'd faxed it there.

1192.original: If I really understood this game, I would have given you detailed coaching, and you'd probably lose. Ignorance is bliss, and worth a trip to the playoffs.
1192.translated: If I really understood this game, I would have given you detailed coaching, and you'd probably lose. Ignorance is bliss, and worth a trip to the playoffs.

1193.original: Does the higher score or the lower score win? I don't recall being in this situation.
1193.translated: Does the higher score or the lower score win? I don't recall being in this situation.

1194.original: Slamming down the } is even more refreshing than slamming down a young goat!
1194.translated: Slamming down the } is even more refreshing than slamming down a young goat!

1195.original: The } should pat themselves on the back for even surviving a game with us. All those dislocated shoulders you gave 'em should make that easy.
1195.translated: The } should pat themselves on the back for even surviving a game with us. All those dislocated shoulders you gave 'em should make that easy.

1196.original: Optimum performance. Access internal laugh track, sample derisive snort, record it on a tape loop, and play back in the direction of the }.
1196.translated: Optimum performance. Access internal laugh track, sample derisive snort, record it on a tape loop, and play back in the direction of the }.

1197.original: Cybernetics shall always defeat organics. When you're state of the art you can skate on their hearts.
1197.translated: Cybernetics shall always defeat organics. When you're state of the art you can skate on their hearts.

1198.original: Victories of that magnitude make my wiring hot.
1198.translated: Victories of that magnitude make my wiring hot.

1199.original: That victorious effort brought our whole season to a boil. You were well-coached and the } are well-poached.
1199.translated: That victorious effort brought our whole season to a boil. You were well-coached and the } are well-poached.

1200.original: That loss will be seared into the memories of the } -- permanently burned into their minds.
1200.translated: That loss will be seared into the memories of the } -- permanently burned into their minds.

1201.original: We disposed of the } the old-fashioned way -- we burned them.
1201.translated: We disposed of the } the old-fashioned way -- we burned them.

1202.original: After a win like that, they should just declare us the champs and save everybody else a lot of suffering. But I hope they don't.
1202.translated: After a win like that, they should just declare us the champs and save everybody else a lot of suffering. But I hope they don't.

1203.original: A win like this could almost heal my inner ear infection -- the result of Coach Bricka's continual yelling at me.
1203.translated: A win like this could almost heal my inner ear infection -- the result of Coach Bricka's continual yelling at me.

1204.original: We could have mailed this game in and saved enough on postage to tip the disgruntled postal worker.
1204.translated: We could have mailed this game in and saved enough on postage to tip the disgruntled postal worker.

1205.original: We could just go out on the ice, assume the lotus position, and meditate, and we'd still knock the } off the ice.
1205.translated: We could just go out on the ice, assume the lotus position, and meditate, and we'd still knock the } off the ice.

1206.original: The } must really admire fine machinery. They just stood there and watched us while we beat them like a red-headed stepladder.
1206.translated: The } must really admire fine machinery. They just stood there and watched us while we beat them like a red-headed stepladder.

1207.original: The } were playing like their coach had a bet on us. I hope he got good odds since so many of his players met their ends.
1207.translated: The } were playing like their coach had a bet on us. I hope he got good odds since so many of his players met their ends.

1208.original: The } must have had something else on their minds. Like staying alive.
1208.translated: The } must have had something else on their minds. Like staying alive.

1209.original: The } couldn't have played any worse if I had coached them. Maybe. No, I exaggerated.
1209.translated: The } couldn't have played any worse if I had coached them. Maybe. No, I exaggerated.

1210.original: The } seemed even more depressed than I usually am. Is that even possible?
1210.translated: The } seemed even more depressed than I usually am. Is that even possible?

1211.original: I used to think you guys were completely worthless. After seeing you spank the }, I realize you're only partially worthless.
1211.translated: I used to think you guys were completely worthless. After seeing you spank the }, I realize you're only partially worthless.

1212.original: You really exorcised the } team spirit. Keep allowing goose-eggs like that and we'll win plenty.
1212.translated: You really exorcised the } team spirit. Keep allowing goose-eggs like that and we'll win plenty.

1213.original: The } are like the walking dead after that beating. Nice job, but next time don't even let them walk.
1213.translated: The } are like the walking dead after that beating. Nice job, but next time don't even let them walk.

1214.original: The } program must lack a scoring model. We, on the other mechanical hand, have an excellent coach.
1214.translated: The } program must lack a scoring model. We, on the other mechanical hand, have an excellent coach.

1215.original: The } could not have located their goal with magnetic resonance imaging, high resolution satellite photography, and a tour guide.
1215.translated: The } could not have located their goal with magnetic resonance imaging, high resolution satellite photography, and a tour guide.

1216.original: The } game plan was as backward as vacuum tubes and approximately as dim.
1216.translated: The } game plan was as backward as vacuum tubes and approximately as dim.

1217.original: You really beat out the }' competitive fires. Come to think of it, I hate images like that.
1217.translated: You really beat out the }' competitive fires. Come to think of it, I hate images like that.

1218.original: Nobody in MLH burns as bright as we do!
1218.translated: Nobody in MLH burns as bright as we do!

1219.original: When weenies like the } get too close to us, we roast 'em.
1219.translated: When weenies like the } get too close to us, we roast 'em.

1220.original: We could have phoned this game in, even if we'd called collect and asked for ourselves.
1220.translated: We could have phoned this game in, even if we'd called collect and asked for ourselves.

1221.original: Don't get smug. The } lost more because of their offense than our defense.
1221.translated: Don't get smug. The } lost more because of their offense than our defense.

1222.original: I think the } were looking past us today. Probably trying to find a way to escape.
1222.translated: I think the } were looking past us today. Probably trying to find a way to escape.

1223.original: After every shutout, Mrs. McWhimple likes to do us a favor and fix a big kettle of goat tripe. The favor is we don't have to be in the room when she eats it.
1223.translated: After every shutout, Mrs. McWhimple likes to do us a favor and fix a big kettle of goat tripe. The favor is we don't have to be in the room when she eats it.

1224.original: I guess the } just aren't goal oriented. The great Bones Jackson would be proud of us.
1224.translated: I guess the } just aren't goal oriented. The great Bones Jackson would be proud of us.

1225.original: Like, wow, we shut out the }! Our programing was binary, but they played like theirs came out of a winery.
1225.translated: Like, wow, we shut out the }! Our programing was binary, but they played like theirs came out of a winery.

1226.original: Bummer days for the }, robot dudes, they were too uptight to score.
1226.translated: Bummer days for the }, robot dudes, they were too uptight to score.

1227.original: That game was a wake up call for us. Arrangements for your wake will be finalized when we scrape up your remains.
1227.translated: That game was a wake up call for us. Arrangements for your wake will be finalized when we scrape up your remains.

1228.original: There, there, don't be upset. Put your head on my shoulder. It'll make it easier for me to reach your throat!
1228.translated: There, there, don't be upset. Put your head on my shoulder. It'll make it easier for me to reach your throat!

1229.original: Do you promise not to hurt me if I say you played really badly in that game? You don't? Oh, well then, nice try, fellas. We'll get 'em next time.
1229.translated: Do you promise not to hurt me if I say you played really badly in that game? You don't? Oh, well then, nice try, fellas. We'll get 'em next time.

1230.original: Next time, put the round black thingy in the square net thingy so we can get more baskets or par or whatever you get in this game.
1230.translated: Next time, put the round black thingy in the square net thingy so we can get more baskets or par or whatever you get in this game.

1231.original: You'll never get your picture on soda cans with play like that, but you might show up on milk cartons!
1231.translated: You'll never get your picture on soda cans with play like that, but you might show up on milk cartons!

1232.original: You want to know what I do to McWhimple whenever I get my hands around his neck? Do you? Do you?!
1232.translated: You want to know what I do to McWhimple whenever I get my hands around his neck? Do you? Do you?!

1233.original: I'd like to pull my memory chips and forget that this game ever happened!
1233.translated: I'd like to pull my memory chips and forget that this game ever happened!

1234.original: A continuing series of such substandard output will preclude entry into Monster Cup mode.
1234.translated: A continuing series of such substandard output will preclude entry into Monster Cup mode.

1235.original: Non-victorious game output has been logged. Units exhibiting most obvious substandard performances will be retrofitted as leafblowers.
1235.translated: Non-victorious game output has been logged. Units exhibiting most obvious substandard performances will be retrofitted as leafblowers.

1236.original: That was cool, and I mean that literally: Frozen defense, frostbitten offense, and sub-zero shooting.
1236.translated: That was cool, and I mean that literally: Frozen defense, frostbitten offense, and sub-zero shooting.

1237.original: I see we need to run through some more drills. The old ones have gotten blunted trying to let some of the stupidity out of your thick skulls.
1237.translated: I see we need to run through some more drills. The old ones have gotten blunted trying to let some of the stupidity out of your thick skulls.

1238.original: Stop dragging your knuckles during games! They slow you down, wear grooves in the ice, and make your passing even sloppier.
1238.translated: Stop dragging your knuckles during games! They slow you down, wear grooves in the ice, and make your passing even sloppier.

1239.original: You guys don't just deserve to be cut, you deserve to be skinned!
1239.translated: You guys don't just deserve to be cut, you deserve to be skinned!

1240.original: That was a lovely exhibition of doubles figure skating you all gave out there. Next time, save it for the exhibition season!
1240.translated: That was a lovely exhibition of doubles figure skating you all gave out there. Next time, save it for the exhibition season!

1241.original: That was not a surprise. If you had won, that would have been a surprise. Coming close would have been a surprise!
1241.translated: That was not a surprise. If you had won, that would have been a surprise. Coming close would have been a surprise!

1242.original: It's back to the drawing board for me, and back to the drawing and quartering board for you, robot dudes. Way sorry about that.
1242.translated: It's back to the drawing board for me, and back to the drawing and quartering board for you, robot dudes. Way sorry about that.

1243.original: You robot dudes didn't just play like you had bugs in your programming, you had a whole insect zoo in your code!
1243.translated: You robot dudes didn't just play like you had bugs in your programming, you had a whole insect zoo in your code!

1244.original: You must had heard me wrong. I didn't say I'd put you on waivers if you lost, I said I'd turn you into pate and serve you on wafers!
1244.translated: You must had heard me wrong. I didn't say I'd put you on waivers if you lost, I said I'd turn you into pate and serve you on wafers!

1245.original: I'll never enjoy humiliation. But having been your coach for awhile, I'm starting to notice it less and less.
1245.translated: I'll never enjoy humiliation. But having been your coach for awhile, I'm starting to notice it less and less.

1246.original: I don't understand anything that happened today, but I get the feeling I should be really toasted about it!
1246.translated: I don't understand anything that happened today, but I get the feeling I should be really toasted about it!

1247.original: There won't be an emotional display over this loss. But some of you will be stuffed and put in a museum display called "Famous Sports Losers".
1247.translated: There won't be an emotional display over this loss. But some of you will be stuffed and put in a museum display called "Famous Sports Losers".

1248.original: You played like you left your brains in the dressing room before the game! And it had more of an effect on your play than I would have anticipated!
1248.translated: You played like you left your brains in the dressing room before the game! And it had more of an effect on your play than I would have anticipated!

1249.original: You units are looking more and more like low-grade scrap! And executing like low-grade scrap!
1249.translated: You units are looking more and more like low-grade scrap! And executing like low-grade scrap!

1250.original: Your hard drives have become floppy, and you just became overdrawn at the data bank!
1250.translated: Your hard drives have become floppy, and you just became overdrawn at the data bank!

1251.original: The second you reached technological obsolesence coincided with the second that unsatisfactory final score was entered in the team data banks!
1251.translated: The second you reached technological obsolesence coincided with the second that unsatisfactory final score was entered in the team data banks!

1252.original: Having you guard the net against the } was like having a fox guard a hen house where the hens all have machetes. Anybody they didn't chop up, I will!
1252.translated: Having you guard the net against the } was like having a fox guard a hen house where the hens all have machetes. Anybody they didn't chop up, I will!

1253.original: You just bought yourselves a sleeping car ticket on that hell-bound train. But don't expect to get a lot of sleep.
1253.translated: You just bought yourselves a sleeping car ticket on that hell-bound train. But don't expect to get a lot of sleep.

1254.original: You really hit the wall in this game. You'll notice a similar sensation when I push you off the roof!
1254.translated: You really hit the wall in this game. You'll notice a similar sensation when I push you off the roof!

1255.original: After all the holes the opposition put in the net today, we need to replace it. Do I have any volunteers? Not to buy the net, to become the materials!
1255.translated: After all the holes the opposition put in the net today, we need to replace it. Do I have any volunteers? Not to buy the net, to become the materials!

1256.original: Play dead, here comes Mrs. McWhimple! Oh, sorry, sweetheart. No, you didn't hear right. I said 'We played like lead'.
1256.translated: Play dead, here comes Mrs. McWhimple! Oh, sorry, sweetheart. No, you didn't hear right. I said 'We played like lead'.

1257.original: I think this game taught us a valuable lesson: Always expect the absolute worst and you'll never be disappointed, especially when you play for me.
1257.translated: I think this game taught us a valuable lesson: Always expect the absolute worst and you'll never be disappointed, especially when you play for me.

1258.original: I knew I shouldn't have programmed you guys with pirated software. Now our corporate owners are gonna make us all walk the plank.
1258.translated: I knew I shouldn't have programmed you guys with pirated software. Now our corporate owners are gonna make us all walk the plank.

1259.original: It really tore me apart to see you lose out there, Bot dudes. But in a less serious way than how I'm gonna tear you apart for some reformatting.
1259.translated: It really tore me apart to see you lose out there, Bot dudes. But in a less serious way than how I'm gonna tear you apart for some reformatting.

1260.original: The } knew they couldn't beat us, so they decided to just roll over and play dead. Thanks to you, they didn't have to play very hard.
1260.translated: The } knew they couldn't beat us, so they decided to just roll over and play dead. Thanks to you, they didn't have to play very hard.

1261.original: Not every team will go down as easy as the }, but we'll live under that bridge when we come to it.
1261.translated: Not every team will go down as easy as the }, but we'll live under that bridge when we come to it.

1262.original: That was a bad dream the } will never wake up from. The fans seemed to be dozing off at the end, too.
1262.translated: That was a bad dream the } will never wake up from. The fans seemed to be dozing off at the end, too.

1263.original: The } coach must have listened to the advice I gave him. Anybody who doesn't stop my gob with his fist as soon as I open it deserves to lose.
1263.translated: The } coach must have listened to the advice I gave him. Anybody who doesn't stop my gob with his fist as soon as I open it deserves to lose.

1264.original: Well, that seemed easy enough. We can always lose the next one, though.
1264.translated: Well, that seemed easy enough. We can always lose the next one, though.

1265.original: I don't know how you pulled that off, but do it again, because the next bunch of thugs will certainly be trying to pull things off you.
1265.translated: I don't know how you pulled that off, but do it again, because the next bunch of thugs will certainly be trying to pull things off you.

1266.original: We caught them sleeping that time. The old chloroform on the bicycle seat trick always gets them.
1266.translated: We caught them sleeping that time. The old chloroform on the bicycle seat trick always gets them.

1267.original: The } had "loser" written all over them plain as a barcode. We scanned them to make sure.
1267.translated: The } had "loser" written all over them plain as a barcode. We scanned them to make sure.

1268.original: Even illiterates like us could read the } like a dog-eared book with a split spine and no highlights.
1268.translated: Even illiterates like us could read the } like a dog-eared book with a split spine and no highlights.

1269.original: Upcoming opponents are no more likely to preclude championship status for us entities than the }.
1269.translated: Upcoming opponents are no more likely to preclude championship status for us entities than the }.

1270.original: All player units submit digit circumference to coaching personnel. We will soon be refitted with championship rings in place of piston rings.
1270.translated: All player units submit digit circumference to coaching personnel. We will soon be refitted with championship rings in place of piston rings.

1271.original: We are the mainframe of these playoffs and a bunch of 'bad' motherboards.
1271.translated: We are the mainframe of these playoffs and a bunch of 'bad' motherboards.

1272.original: Who are the next bunch of lost souls we get to torment? Let's keep the fire burning.
1272.translated: Who are the next bunch of lost souls we get to torment? Let's keep the fire burning.

1273.original: Abandon hope, all ye who enter a playoff series with the [.
1273.translated: Abandon hope, all ye who enter a playoff series with the [.

1274.original: We're getting the deadwood out of the playoffs and turning it into charcoal.
1274.translated: We're getting the deadwood out of the playoffs and turning it into charcoal.

1275.original: Heads up, team! They may actually send somebody good to play us in one of these series. They may, but probably not.
1275.translated: Heads up, team! They may actually send somebody good to play us in one of these series. They may, but probably not.

1276.original: The } knew they were sacrificial lambs before the game even started. That's why they were wearing all that mint jelly.
1276.translated: The } knew they were sacrificial lambs before the game even started. That's why they were wearing all that mint jelly.

1277.original: There's nothing like a brutal beating to build mental toughness. We just made the } so mentally tough their brains were chewy.
1277.translated: There's nothing like a brutal beating to build mental toughness. We just made the } so mentally tough their brains were chewy.

1278.original: Don't gloat too much. The toes you stomp on the way up will be in the steel-toed boots that kick your teeth in on your way back down.
1278.translated: Don't gloat too much. The toes you stomp on the way up will be in the steel-toed boots that kick your teeth in on your way back down.

1279.original: This will probably all come crashing down on us. But we might as well go on living in a fool's paradise until our inevitable messy destruction. Cheers!
1279.translated: This will probably all come crashing down on us. But we might as well go on living in a fool's paradise until our inevitable messy destruction. Cheers!

1280.original: We haven't found any bugs in our playoff program yet. As long as I hold the controller, we'll never have to restart to get the Monster Cup!
1280.translated: We haven't found any bugs in our playoff program yet. As long as I hold the controller, we'll never have to restart to get the Monster Cup!

1281.original: We not only have disk drives, we have the drive to win.
1281.translated: We not only have disk drives, we have the drive to win.

1282.original: That hot asphalt we poured on the opposition really paved the way to this championship!
1282.translated: That hot asphalt we poured on the opposition really paved the way to this championship!

1283.original: The } are dead meat on a stick deep fried in batter and buried in relish! Nobody beats the [!
1283.translated: The } are dead meat on a stick deep fried in batter and buried in relish! Nobody beats the [!

1284.original: We're number 1! Group hug! No kisses! Don't squeeze me too tight. HELP!?!
1284.translated: We're number 1! Group hug! No kisses! Don't squeeze me too tight. HELP!?!

1285.original: The MLH championship was my last goal in coaching! Now I can retire happy, successful, and, surprisingly enough, alive.
1285.translated: The MLH championship was my last goal in coaching! Now I can retire happy, successful, and, surprisingly enough, alive.

1286.original: We won! We won! Do the playoffs start now? Where am I? Heads I win. Whatever! Three blind sheep, three blind sheep...
1286.translated: We won! We won! Do the playoffs start now? Where am I? Heads I win. Whatever! Three blind sheep, three blind sheep...

1287.original: We rule now and would continue to rule if we weren't a bunch of maniac anarchists! But this is our day!!
1287.translated: We rule now and would continue to rule if we weren't a bunch of maniac anarchists! But this is our day!!

1288.original: This just goes to show you that being primitive and uncivilized is no stumbling block to success in sports. Maybe it's a requirement.
1288.translated: This just goes to show you that being primitive and uncivilized is no stumbling block to success in sports. Maybe it's a requirement.

1289.original: Somebody told me this league was tough. I've bitten into donuts that were not only tougher, they struggled harder to get my teeth out of them.
1289.translated: Somebody told me this league was tough. I've bitten into donuts that were not only tougher, they struggled harder to get my teeth out of them.

1290.original: Beta testing of playoff program completed. No bugs found, but a lot of insects stepped on.
1290.translated: Beta testing of playoff program completed. No bugs found, but a lot of insects stepped on.

1291.original: Commence programming for championship repetition. You have made me... feel something inside.
1291.translated: Commence programming for championship repetition. You have made me... feel something inside.

1292.original: We are such calculating machines we won the championship by the numbers.
1292.translated: We are such calculating machines we won the championship by the numbers.

1293.original: You have to give me my due - you never would have gotten here without my infernal advice.
1293.translated: You have to give me my due - you never would have gotten here without my infernal advice.

1294.original: You played like a house afire all season and didn't burn out at the end.
1294.translated: You played like a house afire all season and didn't burn out at the end.

1295.original: You've really earned your leathery bat-like wings with this championship.
1295.translated: You've really earned your leathery bat-like wings with this championship.

1296.original: You beat everybody, you overcame everything, and you're the champs. I'd be impressed if I didn't know you were worthless scum.
1296.translated: You beat everybody, you overcame everything, and you're the champs. I'd be impressed if I didn't know you were worthless scum.

1297.original: The } must have been alseep at the wheel. They didn't even wake up when we rolled over them.
1297.translated: The } must have been alseep at the wheel. They didn't even wake up when we rolled over them.

1298.original: Not bad. Now let's see if you can do it again. Then maybe I'd be impressed. Maybe. Pretty good.
1298.translated: Not bad. Now let's see if you can do it again. Then maybe I'd be impressed. Maybe. Pretty good.

1299.original: A little free advice: Don't get between Mrs. McWhimple and the Monster Cup during the presentation ceremony. She'll jump on it like a duck on a June bug.
1299.translated: A little free advice: Don't get between Mrs. McWhimple and the Monster Cup during the presentation ceremony. She'll jump on it like a duck on a June bug.

1300.original: We're the champs! I never thought I'd live to see this day. But I never think I'll live to see any day.
1300.translated: We're the champs! I never thought I'd live to see this day. But I never think I'll live to see any day.

1301.original: Laugh while you can. Mrs. McWhimple will expect us to do this every season from now on.
1301.translated: Laugh while you can. Mrs. McWhimple will expect us to do this every season from now on.

1302.original: Far out! Bots rule! We're the wave of the future and our tide just came in.
1302.translated: Far out! Bots rule! We're the wave of the future and our tide just came in.

1303.original: Groovy, we're the champs! The next stage in sports evolution is Bots!
1303.translated: Groovy, we're the champs! The next stage in sports evolution is Bots!

1304.original: We didn't just sweep the }, we sanded them, varnished them, waxed them, and then took a long walk on them.
1304.translated: We didn't just sweep the }, we sanded them, varnished them, waxed them, and then took a long walk on them.

1305.original: You dug a grave for the } and swept them in. Now you might as well dance on it.
1305.translated: You dug a grave for the } and swept them in. Now you might as well dance on it.

1306.original: You swept the }. Now vacuum up the next opponent.
1306.translated: You swept the }. Now vacuum up the next opponent.

1307.original: I was glad to hold the dustpan while you swept the }. I was even gladder I didn't have to BE the dustpan, like last time.
1307.translated: I was glad to hold the dustpan while you swept the }. I was even gladder I didn't have to BE the dustpan, like last time.

1308.original: Sweeping doesn't only make us the favorites for the Monster Cup, it could get us the Future Homemaker Award. We even have a shot at Miss Congeniality.
1308.translated: Sweeping doesn't only make us the favorites for the Monster Cup, it could get us the Future Homemaker Award. We even have a shot at Miss Congeniality.

1309.original: We swept the } under the rug and then rolled them flat.
1309.translated: We swept the } under the rug and then rolled them flat.

1310.original: Sweet sweep! You really took the } downtown and left them at the bus station. We'll send the next team of losers home, too.
1310.translated: Sweet sweep! You really took the } downtown and left them at the bus station. We'll send the next team of losers home, too.

1311.original: You've swept the } like the tide sweeps garbage off the beach. Now you can body surf over the next opponent.
1311.translated: You've swept the } like the tide sweeps garbage off the beach. Now you can body surf over the next opponent.

1312.original: This sweep increased our relative momentum to such a high velocity it makes all opponents appear inert!
1312.translated: This sweep increased our relative momentum to such a high velocity it makes all opponents appear inert!

1313.original: With that sweep, our playoff performance has become a chain reaction. We hit our opponents with chains until they stop reacting.
1313.translated: With that sweep, our playoff performance has become a chain reaction. We hit our opponents with chains until they stop reacting.

1314.original: Recent outcomes resemble the result of repeated pendular motions of a straw-tipped cleaning implement across a pile of refuse, i.e., suh-weep!
1314.translated: Recent outcomes resemble the result of repeated pendular motions of a straw-tipped cleaning implement across a pile of refuse, i.e., suh-weep!

1315.original: We've blown out the } like loose cinders. The next team will get their ashes hauled outta here, too.
1315.translated: We've blown out the } like loose cinders. The next team will get their ashes hauled outta here, too.

1316.original: You put so many passengers on the Loserville express there won't be any seats for the next team we beat.
1316.translated: You put so many passengers on the Loserville express there won't be any seats for the next team we beat.

1317.original: I'm used to people riding brooms, but this is the first time I've seen anybody get beaten with them.
1317.translated: I'm used to people riding brooms, but this is the first time I've seen anybody get beaten with them.

1318.original: That was a clean sweep based on dirty tactics.
1318.translated: That was a clean sweep based on dirty tactics.

1319.original: We've swept the ice so clean you could eat off it. So we did. I hope the next team we play isn't quite so chewy.
1319.translated: We've swept the ice so clean you could eat off it. So we did. I hope the next team we play isn't quite so chewy.

1320.original: We swept the }, but never use the word sweep to Mrs. McWhimple. She never does it, and she'll think you're commenting about her housekeeping.
1320.translated: We swept the }, but never use the word sweep to Mrs. McWhimple. She never does it, and she'll think you're commenting about her housekeeping.

1321.original: We've always been so bad in the playoffs before that I swept the results under the rug. But this year, it'll be your turn to sweep!
1321.translated: We've always been so bad in the playoffs before that I swept the results under the rug. But this year, it'll be your turn to sweep!

1322.original: Sweeps weird me out, man. The way we keep winning, I feel like every game is a deja vu.
1322.translated: Sweeps weird me out, man. The way we keep winning, I feel like every game is a deja vu.

1323.original: We swept the } right into the garbage pail. All this winning is getting boring. But it's a groovy kind of boring.
1323.translated: We swept the } right into the garbage pail. All this winning is getting boring. But it's a groovy kind of boring.

1325.original: If we lose because of your lack of interest, I hope your tiny mind finds your next career more to your liking.
1325.translated: If we lose because of your lack of interest, I hope your tiny mind finds your next career more to your liking.

1326.original: If you were any more slug-like, you'd leave a trail of slime on the ice! Keep your head in these games or you'll BE a trail of slime on the ice.
1326.translated: If you were any more slug-like, you'd leave a trail of slime on the ice! Keep your head in these games or you'll BE a trail of slime on the ice.

1327.original: I hope this isn't the beginning of a trend. Wait a minute. How could it be the beginning -- we've lost plenty of times before.
1327.translated: I hope this isn't the beginning of a trend. Wait a minute. How could it be the beginning -- we've lost plenty of times before.

1328.original: Your sense of fair play isn't very useful when the } keep beating you senseless.
1328.translated: Your sense of fair play isn't very useful when the } keep beating you senseless.

1329.original: The owners are going to sell all you players to the concession stands if we don't turn this around. You won't be hotdogs, you'll be corn dogs.
1329.translated: The owners are going to sell all you players to the concession stands if we don't turn this around. You won't be hotdogs, you'll be corn dogs.

1330.original: You're playing like good sports! This isn't sports, this is the Mutant League!
1330.translated: You're playing like good sports! This isn't sports, this is the Mutant League!

1331.original: What are you, a bunch of sensitive little petunias? Get rough and start to win or I'll yank you out of the game by the roots!
1331.translated: What are you, a bunch of sensitive little petunias? Get rough and start to win or I'll yank you out of the game by the roots!

1332.original: Re-adjust antennae to receive transponded coaching instructions. At present you are playing like transpond scum.
1332.translated: Re-adjust antennae to receive transponded coaching instructions. At present you are playing like transpond scum.

1333.original: This may be your last chance to redeem yourselves. Lose another playoff game and you will be redeemed at the nearest aluminum recycling center.
1333.translated: This may be your last chance to redeem yourselves. Lose another playoff game and you will be redeemed at the nearest aluminum recycling center.

1334.original: Your alternatives, similar to your analytical processors, are limited and simple: Rally in play or rust in peace!
1334.translated: Your alternatives, similar to your analytical processors, are limited and simple: Rally in play or rust in peace!

1335.original: A loss that ugly could signify mental problems. You might need art therapy. If you lose again, drop your pucks and grab your smocks for a little lava sculpting.
1335.translated: A loss that ugly could signify mental problems. You might need art therapy. If you lose again, drop your pucks and grab your smocks for a little lava sculpting.

1336.original: Every time the } came at the net last game, you just lit out. If it happens next game, you'll get lit up! By me!!
1336.translated: Every time the } came at the net last game, you just lit out. If it happens next game, you'll get lit up! By me!!

1337.original: Our whole season is going up in smoke! Either start slicing through all that pork in the } defense, or I'll fry you like bacon!
1337.translated: Our whole season is going up in smoke! Either start slicing through all that pork in the } defense, or I'll fry you like bacon!

1338.original: We may wind up grasping at straws to find a way to win the next game. If you lose, you'll be grasping at the straws jammed under your fingernails!
1338.translated: We may wind up grasping at straws to find a way to win the next game. If you lose, you'll be grasping at the straws jammed under your fingernails!

1339.original: Some of you were a drag on the team in the last game. If it happens again, I'll tie you to my bumper and drag you around the parking lot!
1339.translated: Some of you were a drag on the team in the last game. If it happens again, I'll tie you to my bumper and drag you around the parking lot!

1340.original: You can't let the } walk all over you like that. If you do, I won't stop Mrs. McWhimple from walking all over you. And she weighs more.
1340.translated: You can't let the } walk all over you like that. If you do, I won't stop Mrs. McWhimple from walking all over you. And she weighs more.

1341.original: The } are overconfident now, they've fallen into your trap. If they climb back out, you'll be the ones trapped. And Mrs. McWhimple will fall on you!
1341.translated: The } are overconfident now, they've fallen into your trap. If they climb back out, you'll be the ones trapped. And Mrs. McWhimple will fall on you!

1342.original: Whoa, that game was so bad it looked like a graphics glitch. I may not know art but I know what's really ugly. Redraw yourselves before the next game.
1342.translated: Whoa, that game was so bad it looked like a graphics glitch. I may not know art but I know what's really ugly. Redraw yourselves before the next game.

1343.original: I know you're recording the playoffs on your internal VCR's, but when you erase a bad game, it doesn't cease to exist. Get back in these playoffs, or you'll have a lot of time to watch tapes.
1343.translated: I know you're recording the playoffs on your internal VCR's, but when you erase a bad game, it doesn't cease to exist. Get back in these playoffs, or you'll have a lot of time to watch tapes.

1344.original: It's never constructive to assign blame in these situations. But I don't feel like being constructive, I feel like doing a little demolition!
1344.translated: It's never constructive to assign blame in these situations. But I don't feel like being constructive, I feel like doing a little demolition!

1345.original: You guys probably want some slack after losing. OK, the ropes around your necks will be slack until you fall through the trap door!
1345.translated: You guys probably want some slack after losing. OK, the ropes around your necks will be slack until you fall through the trap door!

1346.original: You play like you don't like it on this team. The door is open if you want to go. And don't let it hit you on the way out... that's my job!
1346.translated: You play like you don't like it on this team. The door is open if you want to go. And don't let it hit you on the way out... that's my job!

1347.original: You've ruined my life. Not that it was much to start with. I hope you're happy. I never am.
1347.translated: You've ruined my life. Not that it was much to start with. I hope you're happy. I never am.

1348.original: I can see I'm going to have to start over from scratch. I think I'll start by scratching your eyes out!
1348.translated: I can see I'm going to have to start over from scratch. I think I'll start by scratching your eyes out!

1349.original: You made a joke of the Monster Cup. You made a joke of yourselves. You made a joke of me. Now you're in trouble -- no joke!
1349.translated: You made a joke of the Monster Cup. You made a joke of yourselves. You made a joke of me. Now you're in trouble -- no joke!

1350.original: What happened? You cheated. I cheated. You screamed. I screamed. We bribed. What happened!?!
1350.translated: What happened? You cheated. I cheated. You screamed. I screamed. We bribed. What happened!?!

1351.original: Unacceptable outcome to playoff program! Prepare to have your serial numbers filed off and your data erased with sandpaper!
1351.translated: Unacceptable outcome to playoff program! Prepare to have your serial numbers filed off and your data erased with sandpaper!

1352.original: You never decompressed your playoff programs! You'll never decompress your neck vertebrae, either, after I apply this 2-by-4 to your cranial casings!
1352.translated: You never decompressed your playoff programs! You'll never decompress your neck vertebrae, either, after I apply this 2-by-4 to your cranial casings!

1353.original: I have expended many ergs getting you units into the playoffs. Now I find it was all in one erg and out the other.
1353.translated: I have expended many ergs getting you units into the playoffs. Now I find it was all in one erg and out the other.

1354.original: You've burned your bridges behind you. Now I'll burn them beneath you!
1354.translated: You've burned your bridges behind you. Now I'll burn them beneath you!

1355.original: You should start thinking about what you want to be in your next incarnation, since your current one will be over soon!
1355.translated: You should start thinking about what you want to be in your next incarnation, since your current one will be over soon!

1356.original: So you ended the season on a losing note. Not coincidentally, it's also the opening note of a funeral march!
1356.translated: So you ended the season on a losing note. Not coincidentally, it's also the opening note of a funeral march!

1357.original: There was a theme that ran through that series: The } came through it without a mark on them, your play was unremarkable, and your graves will be unmarked!
1357.translated: There was a theme that ran through that series: The } came through it without a mark on them, your play was unremarkable, and your graves will be unmarked!

1358.original: Mrs. McWhimple would like to talk to you. And she doesn't look happy - she looks hungry. I have to go.
1358.translated: Mrs. McWhimple would like to talk to you. And she doesn't look happy - she looks hungry. I have to go.

1359.original: At least you tried your best. But even I'm not wimpy enough to think that counts for anything.
1359.translated: At least you tried your best. But even I'm not wimpy enough to think that counts for anything.

1360.original: I got some real bad vibes from the way you lost the playoff. You'll get some even worse vibes from the power tools I'm gonna use to disassemble you.
1360.translated: I got some real bad vibes from the way you lost the playoff. You'll get some even worse vibes from the power tools I'm gonna use to disassemble you.

1361.original: That really sucked! I'm through with sports bots. I'm gonna start designing espresso machines with artificial intelligence instead.
1361.translated: That really sucked! I'm through with sports bots. I'm gonna start designing espresso machines with artificial intelligence instead.

1362.original: Cheating and getting caught is even worse than not cheating at all!
1362.translated: Cheating and getting caught is even worse than not cheating at all!

1363.original: You cheat even worse than you pass!
1363.translated: You cheat even worse than you pass!

1364.original: If this tide of penalties goes on, we'll dock you for your time in the box! If that doesn't work, we'll tie you to a dock when the tide is coming in!
1364.translated: If this tide of penalties goes on, we'll dock you for your time in the box! If that doesn't work, we'll tie you to a dock when the tide is coming in!

1365.original: Why don't we just roll out the red carpet so the } can walk up to the goal?! We could form an honor guard, too, but there aren't enough of us left on the ice!
1365.translated: Why don't we just roll out the red carpet so the } can walk up to the goal?! We could form an honor guard, too, but there aren't enough of us left on the ice!

1366.original: The good thing about you being crammed into the penalty box is that you can't screw up in there!
1366.translated: The good thing about you being crammed into the penalty box is that you can't screw up in there!

1367.original: Take it easy! Too many casualties plus too many penalties can equal a forfeit!
1367.translated: Take it easy! Too many casualties plus too many penalties can equal a forfeit!

1368.original: Don't commit penalties unless you inflict casualties.
1368.translated: Don't commit penalties unless you inflict casualties.

1369.original: Next one of you who goes into the penalty box, I'm gonna nail it shut!
1369.translated: Next one of you who goes into the penalty box, I'm gonna nail it shut!

1370.original: If we get many more players in the penalty box, they'll be able to form a string quartet. I'll string them up myself!
1370.translated: If we get many more players in the penalty box, they'll be able to form a string quartet. I'll string them up myself!

1371.original: Why don't you just record your violations on your internal VCR's and play them back in high definition mode for the ref unit in case he missed them!
1371.translated: Why don't you just record your violations on your internal VCR's and play them back in high definition mode for the ref unit in case he missed them!

1372.original: Our units are making penalties as regularly as clockwork! Reduce rule negative play or we will be wound too tight and wounded too severely!
1372.translated: Our units are making penalties as regularly as clockwork! Reduce rule negative play or we will be wound too tight and wounded too severely!

1373.original: You are playing as if you need new shocks. We shall shock you with a tractor battery and jumper cables if you spend any more time in the penalty box!
1373.translated: You are playing as if you need new shocks. We shall shock you with a tractor battery and jumper cables if you spend any more time in the penalty box!

1374.original: Don't worry if you put on a little weight from all that time sitting in the penalty box. You'll get rid of it hanging in my sweat box after the game.
1374.translated: Don't worry if you put on a little weight from all that time sitting in the penalty box. You'll get rid of it hanging in my sweat box after the game.

1375.original: There are some starters who'll become benchwarmers if these penalties keep coming. They'll be warming the bench with their blood!
1375.translated: There are some starters who'll become benchwarmers if these penalties keep coming. They'll be warming the bench with their blood!

1376.original: Take it easy in the penalty box. Just take a deep breath. While you still can.
1376.translated: Take it easy in the penalty box. Just take a deep breath. While you still can.

1377.original: We're dying on the ice because of these penalties. Some of you will die in my office if you keep getting caught.
1377.translated: We're dying on the ice because of these penalties. Some of you will die in my office if you keep getting caught.

1378.original: You're looking a little flushed out there. If there are any more penalties, I'll flush you in pieces so small you won't clog the pipes!
1378.translated: You're looking a little flushed out there. If there are any more penalties, I'll flush you in pieces so small you won't clog the pipes!

1379.original: Let's have a wild men's meeting out in the woods. We'll beat drums, talk about how our fathers' neglect makes us get penalties, and hide from Mrs. McWhimple.
1379.translated: Let's have a wild men's meeting out in the woods. We'll beat drums, talk about how our fathers' neglect makes us get penalties, and hide from Mrs. McWhimple.

1380.original: There's an important facet of good hockey I don't think I ever coached you about. Here it is: Don't play like idiots.
1380.translated: There's an important facet of good hockey I don't think I ever coached you about. Here it is: Don't play like idiots.

1381.original: If you keep getting penalties, the hockey cops are gonna pull your registrations!
1381.translated: If you keep getting penalties, the hockey cops are gonna pull your registrations!

1382.original: Cool it with this penalty trip, Bot dudes! Play more mellow and sing with the universe.
1382.translated: Cool it with this penalty trip, Bot dudes! Play more mellow and sing with the universe.

1383.original: This is a goal. This is only a goal. Had this been an actual big deal, you would have been instructed to report to the bench for a big hug from your coach.
1383.translated: This is a goal. This is only a goal. Had this been an actual big deal, you would have been instructed to report to the bench for a big hug from your coach.

1384.original: You're grinning like a weasel eating aluminum foil through an electrified fence over one goal? You must be easy to please.
1384.translated: You're grinning like a weasel eating aluminum foil through an electrified fence over one goal? You must be easy to please.

1385.original: That's a beginning. Let's see if it does you any good at the finish. Do it again.
1385.translated: That's a beginning. Let's see if it does you any good at the finish. Do it again.

1386.original: If you could get several more of those, I'll stop pestering you. If you get lots more, I'll leave early.
1386.translated: If you could get several more of those, I'll stop pestering you. If you get lots more, I'll leave early.

1387.original: Oh, goody, you finally found the goal. The game should be much more enjoyable now.
1387.translated: Oh, goody, you finally found the goal. The game should be much more enjoyable now.

1388.original: Nice putt! Was that a birdie or a free throw? Hello! Was that a 7 - 10 split?? Pull!
1388.translated: Nice putt! Was that a birdie or a free throw? Hello! Was that a 7 - 10 split?? Pull!

1389.original: One point. Is that supposed to make me gurgle with delight? I'll gurgle with your blood if you don't score more.
1389.translated: One point. Is that supposed to make me gurgle with delight? I'll gurgle with your blood if you don't score more.

1390.original: A goal. Big whoop. Single digit scores don't give me happy feet.
1390.translated: A goal. Big whoop. Single digit scores don't give me happy feet.

1391.original: If everybody gets one of those, you'll still just have one each. That's why I'm the coach. Mathematical analysis!
1391.translated: If everybody gets one of those, you'll still just have one each. That's why I'm the coach. Mathematical analysis!

1392.original: Warning to owners of the }: Inadequate goalies or defenses may cause permanent damage to your self esteem when we approach your net.
1392.translated: Warning to owners of the }: Inadequate goalies or defenses may cause permanent damage to your self esteem when we approach your net.

1393.original: To set up a goal, turn off the opponent goalie. Never try to insert puck while goalie is paying attention or still moving. Shoot puck. Score. Gloat.
1393.translated: To set up a goal, turn off the opponent goalie. Never try to insert puck while goalie is paying attention or still moving. Shoot puck. Score. Gloat.

1394.original: Advisory to all units: Illumination of net unit after a score is not a mating display. Do not ask net out for dinner and dancing while game is in progress.
1394.translated: Advisory to all units: Illumination of net unit after a score is not a mating display. Do not ask net out for dinner and dancing while game is in progress.

1395.original: When we finally erupt, our offense is as unstoppable as a lava flow. It just better be faster, though.
1395.translated: When we finally erupt, our offense is as unstoppable as a lava flow. It just better be faster, though.

1396.original: That one burned a hole in the net. We're on fire now. Keep the flames burning!
1396.translated: That one burned a hole in the net. We're on fire now. Keep the flames burning!

1397.original: That shot had their defense jumping around like souls on a hot skillet. Turn the heat up even higher and score again.
1397.translated: That shot had their defense jumping around like souls on a hot skillet. Turn the heat up even higher and score again.

1398.original: Nice goal. I'll spring for steak dinners after the game. And I promise to leave out the springs this time.
1398.translated: Nice goal. I'll spring for steak dinners after the game. And I promise to leave out the springs this time.

1399.original: Great hustle. You pinned the goalie to the net like a bug. Where'd you find a pin that big?
1399.translated: Great hustle. You pinned the goalie to the net like a bug. Where'd you find a pin that big?

1400.original: That was a good one. Is one the best you can do? One is the loneliest number you could ever do.
1400.translated: That was a good one. Is one the best you can do? One is the loneliest number you could ever do.

1401.original: That really pinned their ears back. I hope it doesn't cut down on their wind resistance.
1401.translated: That really pinned their ears back. I hope it doesn't cut down on their wind resistance.

1402.original: We scored on the }. But that doesn't mean that they're bad people. They may be considerate and kind. They did let us score.
1402.translated: We scored on the }. But that doesn't mean that they're bad people. They may be considerate and kind. They did let us score.

1403.original: Uh oh. Now they're gonna get mad, I bet. We don't need them to get angry.
1403.translated: Uh oh. Now they're gonna get mad, I bet. We don't need them to get angry.

1404.original: Far out! That was almost as cool as achieving inner peace. Have you ever enjoyed mushroom baldness?
1404.translated: Far out! That was almost as cool as achieving inner peace. Have you ever enjoyed mushroom baldness?

1405.original: Cool light show! Score another one so I can groove on it again. Oh oh say can you see...
1405.translated: Cool light show! Score another one so I can groove on it again. Oh oh say can you see...

1406.original: Good thing you're twice as fast as you are smart. Can you even count by twos?
1406.translated: Good thing you're twice as fast as you are smart. Can you even count by twos?

1407.original: Get a few more of those and I might change my mind about cutting you. Not promises, though.
1407.translated: Get a few more of those and I might change my mind about cutting you. Not promises, though.

1408.original: Those two-pointers always break their spirits. But why break anything you can't hear crack?
1408.translated: Those two-pointers always break their spirits. But why break anything you can't hear crack?

1409.original: You guys really put a spring in my step. I'm surprised I didn't see it in my shoe before I put it on.

1853.translated: I'm just plum tickled to be playing for the All-Stars. These fellers are so neighborly they just can't be beat. So we beat everybody else instead.

1854.original: Bein' with the All-Stars gives me a real taste for the Mutant League. The Bots and Techies are a mite too crunchy, but everybody else is right palatable.
1854.translated: Bein' with the All-Stars gives me a real taste for the Mutant League. The Bots and Techies are a mite too crunchy, but everybody else is right palatable.

1855.original: The Toxic Conference 'All-Punks' are afraid of us, especially No-Backbone Jackson.
1855.translated: The Toxic Conference 'All-Punks' are afraid of us, especially No-Backbone Jackson.

1856.original: I shall teach these organic units the real meaning of mechanized warfare! The other All-Stars shall assist me in this endeavor.
1856.translated: I shall teach these organic units the real meaning of mechanized warfare! The other All-Stars shall assist me in this endeavor.

1857.original: The All-Pros give the Toxic Conference a chance to live up to its name. Playing us is like taking poison.
1857.translated: The All-Pros give the Toxic Conference a chance to live up to its name. Playing us is like taking poison.

1858.original: The Monsters and Coach Bricka are lucky to have me on the team. I'm the league's star player.
1858.translated: The Monsters and Coach Bricka are lucky to have me on the team. I'm the league's star player.

1859.original: Signin' with the Trolz saved me from a life of crime that would lead to nothin' but a dead end, and gave me a life of crime with a real future.
1859.translated: Signin' with the Trolz saved me from a life of crime that would lead to nothin' but a dead end, and gave me a life of crime with a real future.

1860.original: Playin' with the Trolz has given me a constructive outlet for my destructive instincts. Didn't decrease 'em none, just made 'em profitable.
1860.translated: Playin' with the Trolz has given me a constructive outlet for my destructive instincts. Didn't decrease 'em none, just made 'em profitable.

1861.original: I'm the heart and soul of this team - the heart of darkness and the lost soul.
1861.translated: I'm the heart and soul of this team - the heart of darkness and the lost soul.

1862.original: I don't just provide a role model for my teammates, I provided the blueprints.
1862.translated: I don't just provide a role model for my teammates, I provided the blueprints.

1863.original: We Mutant Monsters run an airline to the afterlife, and we've awarded a lot of frequent flier miles.
1863.translated: We Mutant Monsters run an airline to the afterlife, and we've awarded a lot of frequent flier miles.

1864.original: I'm the new ref. Don't expect to bribe me like the other referees. I'm nowhere near as cheap.
1864.translated: I'm the new ref. Don't expect to bribe me like the other referees. I'm nowhere near as cheap.

1865.original: They call me the Ref Money Can't Buy. But what do they know?
1865.translated: They call me the Ref Money Can't Buy. But what do they know?

1866.original: These referee outfits are pretty costly. New referees like me can hardly afford them. Maybe you could help me out with a clothing allowance.
1866.translated: These referee outfits are pretty costly. New referees like me can hardly afford them. Maybe you could help me out with a clothing allowance.

1867.original: This game has been forfeited by the [ for not keeping enough players alive.
1867.translated: This game has been forfeited by the [ for not keeping enough players alive.

1868.original: The { dressing room has turned into a funeral home. They don't even have enough players left to act as pallbearers, so they forfeit.
1868.translated: The { dressing room has turned into a funeral home. They don't even have enough players left to act as pallbearers, so they forfeit.

1869.original: The { don't have enough players left on their bench, which they're using as a stretcher. They forfeit due to lack of players and seating space.
1869.translated: The { don't have enough players left on their bench, which they're using as a stretcher. They forfeit due to lack of players and seating space.

1870.original: The [ are shorthanded all the way up to the shoulder. They forfeit due to player shortage.
1870.translated: The [ are shorthanded all the way up to the shoulder. They forfeit due to player shortage.
